name: OpenMind
full_name: OpenMind: Large-Scale Brain MRI Pretraining Dataset
protocol_note: 23 different MRI modalities/techniques including T1w, T2, inplaneT2 and others
size: ~114K MRI images (1.04 TB) curated from 800 OpenNeuro datasets across 30+ scanners
segmentation_detail: Includes deface masks and anatomy masks (not tumor/organ segmentation targets)
description: A large-scale brain MRI pretraining dataset of ~114K NIfTI images spanning 23 sequence types curated from 800 OpenNeuro datasets across 30+ scanners for self-supervised foundation models.

label_schema: Self-supervised pretraining corpus - NO expert segmentation/classification targets (no tumor/organ/lesion labels)
Companion 'deface_mask' - mask delineating the anonymized/defaced region of each volume (for reconstruction/inpainting-aware SSL)
Companion 'fb_mask' (anatomy/foreground mask) - mask delineating voxels that contain actual anatomy vs. background/empty space (e.g. for brain-extracted images)
Per-image metadata labels: MR modality/technique (23 types, 100% coverage), scanner manufacturer/model/field strength (100%)
Demographic/clinical metadata (partial coverage): Age (~70%), Sex (~77%), Handedness (~35%), Health status (~26%), Race (~12%), BMI (~16%), Weight (~1.5%)
details.file_structure: Modified BIDS layout of gzipped NIfTI (.nii.gz) volumes organized by OpenNeuro dataset ID / subject / session / anatomy; each image has a sibling folder '<image>__Data/' holding deface_mask.nii.gz and fb_mask.nii.gz, and a top-level openneuro_metadata.csv maps relative paths plus all metadata for the ~114k images.
details.extra: ~114,000 3D head/brain MRI volumes aggregated from ~800 OpenNeuro datasets (>30 scanners); masks are algorithmic/companion aids for SSL, not human-annotated diagnostic labels, and the HuggingFace viewer's 45/193 'rows' are dataset-index groupings, not sample-level train/test splits.

related.name: OpenNeuro
related.note: 114k 3D head/neck MRI images pooled from 800 OpenNeuro datasets in modified BIDS NIfTI layout, with added deface and anatomy masks and unified metadata

name: fastMRI Prostate
full_name: fastMRI Prostate: A Public, Biparametric MRI Dataset
protocol_note: Axial T2-weighted and axial diffusion-weighted (DWI) sequences (biparametric)
license: fastMRI Data Sharing Agreement (research use only)
description: Raw multi-coil k-space data from 312 prostate MRI exams acquired on 3T scanners, comprising axial T2-weighted and diffusion-weighted acquisitions for accelerated reconstruction research.

label_schema: Slice-level labels indicating the presence and grade of prostate cancer
Labels provided at slice-, volume-, and exam-level for both the T2-weighted and diffusion-weighted (DWI) sequences
Intended target task: detection/classification of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa)
details.file_structure: Per-exam HDF5 (.h5) files containing raw multi-coil k-space measurements plus calibration/phase-correction data (and coil sensitivity/ESPIRiT maps) with separate axial T2-weighted and axial diffusion-weighted acquisitions; annotation label files are distributed alongside and keyed to the exam filenames (the released classification code consumes the label files and filenames directly).
details.extra: Dataset comprises 312 biparametric prostate MRI exams acquired on 3 Tesla scanners (axial T2 + axial DWI), released April 2023 as an expansion of the fastMRI dataset; the original release centers on raw k-space for reconstruction, with the cancer labels supporting a downstream csPCa classification task (separate T2 and DWI models). Exact official train/validation/test counts could not be verified.

name: fastMRI Breast
full_name: fastMRI Breast DCE-MRI k-space Dataset
protocol_note: Axial dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) 3D GRASP sequence acquired at 3T
size: 300 clinical exams
license: fastMRI Data Sharing Agreement (research use only)
description: Raw k-space data from 300 clinical breast DCE-MRI exams acquired on 3T scanners with a 3D GRASP sequence for accelerated MRI reconstruction research.

label_schema: Cohort composition: 51 exams no suspicious lesion, 159 benign, 90 malignant
Malignant lesion type: invasive ductal carcinoma (55), invasive lobular carcinoma (10), mixed (7), ductal carcinoma in situ (18)
Additional per-case metadata: patient age, menopause status, reason for exam, laterality of malignant findings, modality malignancy first observed, tumor grade, tumor biomarkers
details.file_structure: Per-case folders named by patient code (e.g. fastMRI_breast_003_2) each holding raw radial k-space in HDF5 (.h5) plus reconstructed clinical images in DICOM; all case-level labels/metadata are supplied separately in an Excel spreadsheet (breast_fastMRI_final.xlsx), not embedded per pixel.
details.splits: Split 80:20 into training and testing cohorts (lesion-type ratios preserved); no separate validation split defined.
details.extra: No segmentation masks or bounding-box annotations are provided — the authors state the dataset is currently less suitable for supervised segmentation. 284 patients / 300 exams (16 patients rescanned ~1 year later), axial DCE-MRI acquired with a 3D GRASP golden-angle radial sequence at 3T.

name: K2S
full_name: K2S: From Undersampled K-space To Automatic Segmentation Challenge
protocol_note: High-resolution 3D fat-suppressed FSE Cube knee MRI; 8x undersampled multi-channel k-space plus fully-sampled auxiliary images for training
segmentation_detail: Bone and cartilage tissue segmentation masks paired with fully-sampled/undersampled k-space and reconstructed images
description: Grand Challenge dataset of 300 training and 50 test 3D fat-suppressed FSE-Cube knee MRIs providing 8x undersampled multi-channel k-space, fully-sampled images, and bone/cartilage segmentation masks for joint MRI reconstruction and segmentation.

label_schema: 6 tissue segmentation classes total, grouped for scoring into bone and cartilage
Evaluation collapses classes into 2 groups (bone, cartilage) scored with volume-weighted Dice (weights inversely proportional to structure size)
details.file_structure: 3D fat-suppressed FSE-CUBE knee MRI provided as 8x-undersampled multi-channel k-space plus fully-sampled auxiliary reconstructed images, with paired dense bone/cartilage segmentation masks; k-space, images, and masks are distributed as HDF5 (.h5) files and predicted test masks must also be submitted as HDF5.
details.splits: 300 training/validation cases (no official validation split — participants create their own) and 50 test cases
details.extra: Test-set segmentation ground truth was never released; fully-sampled images are given only as training auxiliary data (not available for test-set inference), and the organizers state no data is shared after the challenge concluded.

name: M4Raw
full_name: M4Raw: A Multi-contrast, Multi-repetition, Multi-channel MRI k-space Dataset for Low-field MRI Research
protocol_note: T1-weighted, T2-weighted, FLAIR, and GRE contrasts, each with multiple repetitions for multi-repetition averaging
description: Multi-channel brain MRI k-space data from 183 healthy volunteers scanned on a 0.3T low-field whole-body scanner, with T1/T2/FLAIR/GRE contrasts and multiple repetitions to enable low-field MRI reconstruction and denoising research.

label_schema: Reconstruction/denoising target (regression): no human annotations; the 'ground truth' is a high-SNR reference image
Reference image = the multi-repetition average of the repeated acquisitions for each contrast, used as the target for reconstructing/denoising the single-repetition (noisy) inputs
Contrast/acquisition metadata per volume: T1-weighted, T2-weighted, FLAIR (plus GRE added in v1.5+)
details.file_structure: Raw multi-coil brain k-space stored as fastMRI-style HDF5 (.h5) files (one file per acquisition/repetition), organized into train/val/test folders; each contrast has multiple repetitions per subject so single-repetition files are the input and their average serves as the reference target (no separate segmentation/annotation files).
details.splits: Training and validation subsets of ~1024 and ~240 volumes respectively; v1.6 adds a test set of 25 subjects (183 healthy volunteers total).
details.extra: 0.3 Tesla low-field scanner; ~1.2 mm in-plane and 5 mm through-plane resolution; CC-BY-4.0; Lyu et al., Scientific Data 2023 (DOI: 10.1038/s41597-023-02181-4). No segmentation, classification, or detection labels.

name: ACRIN-NSCLC-FDG-PET
full_name: Data from the ACRIN 6668 Trial NSCLC-FDG-PET
protocol_note: Whole-body FDG-PET (with or without PET/CT), upper/mid neck to proximal femurs, emission 50-70 min post-injection; recommended dose 0.14-0.21 mCi/kg; pre-treatment and ~14 weeks post-chemoradiotherapy on the same scanner. Collection also includes NM, MR, CR, DX, SC series.
segmentation_detail: Tumor segmentations available separately via the BAMF AIMI Annotations initiative (not part of the primary TCIA release)
paired_text_detail: Clinical XLS spreadsheets: demographics, diagnosis, treatment, follow-up, and measurement data (anonymized)
description: 242 NSCLC patients from the ACRIN 6668/RTOG 0235 trial with serial pre- and post-chemoradiotherapy FDG PET/CT DICOM imaging plus clinical and outcome spreadsheets.

label_schema: Primary TCIA release provides no image segmentations; annotations are reader quantitative measurements and clinical forms, not pixel labels
Reader measurements per lesion: SUVmax (maximum single-voxel standardized uptake value) and SUVpeak (mean SUV in a 0.75-1.5 cm ROI), by institutional and central readers
Quantified FDG uptake targets: primary tumor, regional lymph nodes, and common sites of distant metastasis
Clinical form categories: Demographic, Diagnosis, Follow-Up, Measurement, Treatment
Companion BAMF segmentation: single foreground class = FDG-avid lesion (tumor), restricted to pulmonary/pleural region (Label 1 = lesion; binary mask)
details.file_structure: Primary TCIA release stores per-patient DICOM images (PET, CT, NM, MR, CR, DX, SC) with clinical/reader data in XLS/CSV spreadsheets; the separate BAMF AIMI companion provides tumor masks as DICOM-SEG (one per scan, or NIfTI .nii.gz fallback), distributed via Zenodo record 8352041 (lung-fdg-pet-ct.zip), not in the TCIA release.
details.splits: Clinical/reader spreadsheets are split into File Set 1 (75% random sample) and File Set 2 (25% random sample); no official train/val/test split for the imaging or segmentation annotations.
details.extra: BAMF masks are auto-generated by an nnU-Net FDG-PET/CT lesion model (trained on AutoPET 2023, ensembled over 5 folds) with lesions limited to lung/pleura via TotalSegmentator; only ~10% of cases were reviewed/corrected by a radiologist (plus a non-expert), so most masks are unverified AI output.

name: ACRIN-HNSCC-FDG-PET-CT
full_name: ACRIN 6685: A Multicenter Trial of FDG-PET/CT Staging of Head and Neck Cancer
protocol_note: Dedicated head-and-neck FDG-PET/CT (two bed positions, orbits to aortic arch, 6 min/bed) and/or whole-body PET/CT; contrast-enhanced MRI or CT of the neck within 4 weeks of surgery; modalities listed: CT, PT, MR, NM.
segmentation_detail: Tumor annotations available via related analysis result 'ACRIN 6685-Tumor-Annotations'
paired_text_detail: Clinical data (classification, demographic, diagnosis, follow-up, measurement, treatment) provided as XLS/CSV/PDF with data dictionary
conditions: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
license: NIH Controlled Data Access (imaging); CC BY 4.0 (clinical)
description: 260 head-and-neck cancer patients from the ACRIN 6685 multicenter trial with FDG PET/CT staging imaging, tumor annotations, and pathology-correlated clinical data hosted on TCIA.

label_schema: Lesion-level tumor annotations (head and neck squamous cell carcinoma) - no fixed integer class map; each annotated lesion is one structure
3D segmentation contours of measurable tumor lesions
Negative-findings assessment per scan (indicates no annotatable lesion present)
Inclusion criteria: lymph nodes >1 cm short-axis and other lesions >1 cm; max 5 lesions per scan timepoint, no more than 2 per organ
Measurement standards followed: RECIST 1.1 (CT/MR) and PERCIST (PET)
details.file_structure: DICOM data organized per subject on TCIA; annotations distributed as DICOM RTSTRUCT (segmentations), plus seed points and negative-findings assessments, referencing the source CT and attenuation-corrected PET (and MR) series.
details.extra: Multi-reader: scans initially annotated by an international team of radiologists (MBBS or higher) then reviewed by US-based board-certified radiologists; 258 subjects / 481 studies / 2,085 series in the 'ACRIN 6685-Tumor-Annotations' analysis result (a subset of the 260-subject parent collection).

name: ACRIN-FMISO-Brain
full_name: ACRIN 6684: Assessment of Tumor Hypoxia in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Using 18F-FMISO PET and MRI
protocol_note: Multiple MRI sequences alongside 18F-FMISO PET and low-dose CT
size: 96 GB
segmentation_detail: Binary DICOM VOI masks: 18F-FMISO PET hypoxia maps and MRI enhancing tumor lesion masks
paired_text_detail: ~30 clinical forms (~2,000 elements) with demographics, diagnosis, treatment, follow-up, and pathology biomarkers (MGMT status, HIF1-alpha, GLUT1, CAIX, CD31, alpha-SMA); provided as CSV/XLSX
license: CC BY 3.0 (clinical data); NIH Controlled Data Access (imaging)
description: TCIA collection of 45 newly diagnosed glioblastoma patients imaged with 18F-FMISO hypoxia PET plus MRI and low-dose CT, including binary DICOM hypoxia and enhancing-tumor VOI masks and detailed clinical forms.

label_schema: Binary VOI mask, value 1 = inside region of interest, value 0 = outside
18F-FMISO PET hypoxia VOI: hypoxic voxels defined by tumor-to-cerebellar activity ratio greater than 1.2
MRI enhancing tumor lesion VOI: contrast-enhancing tumor delineated on calibrated pre/post-contrast T1 series
details.file_structure: Two sets of binary segmentation masks, each stored as a single DICOM volume (voxel value 1 inside the VOI, 0 outside); provided as separate downloads for the hypoxia PET masks and the MRI tumor masks (not DICOM-SEG or RTSTRUCT).
details.extra: Analysis/segmentation collection accompanying the ACRIN 6684 clinical trial imaging (glioblastoma); roughly 45 patients, so masks cover only a subset of the full imaging cohort.

name: ACRIN-FLT-Breast
full_name: ACRIN 6688: 18F-FLT PET/CT in Breast Cancer
protocol_note: 18F-FLT PET/CT (dynamic 45-frame single-FOV FLT plus whole-body FLT at 1 h) and 18F-FDG PET/CT (whole-body at 1 h, dual time point at 2 h); PET AC and NAC reconstructions with attenuation-correction CT; OT series also included.
paired_text_detail: ~40 clinical forms (CSV/XLS): demographics, medical history, treatment, pathology, measurements, follow-up
description: 83 locally advanced breast-cancer patients from the ACRIN 6688 Phase II trial with 18F-FLT and FDG PET/CT imaging for early neoadjuvant chemotherapy response assessment.

label_schema: No image-level segmentations or bounding boxes: no DICOM-SEG/RTSTRUCT provided
Labels are patient-level clinical/outcome variables from ~40 case report forms (several thousand elements) encoded from the ACRIN 6688 trial
Primary outcome: pathologic complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant chemotherapy
Ki-67 tissue proliferation marker (correlated with 18F-FLT uptake)
Follow-up outcome variables including dates of progression and survival
Demographics (all female, mean age ~51.7 years) and pathology variables
details.file_structure: DICOM images (CT, 18F-FLT and 18F-FDG PET, and OT) organized by patient/study/series on TCIA; clinical form data supplied separately as CSV files accompanied by a Data Dictionary describing each variable and its coded values.
details.extra: 83 patients / 363 studies / 1,480 series / ~688,598 images; PET includes dynamic 45-frame FLT sequences and both attenuation-corrected (AC) and non-corrected (NAC) reconstructions. No annotation masks exist, so labels are tabular clinical endpoints rather than pixel/region labels.

name: Anti-PD-1_Melanoma
full_name: Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy Melanoma
protocol_note: Data types listed as MR, CT, PT (PET); sequences, contrast phases and PET tracer not specified on the official page.
paired_text_detail: Patient outcomes and treatment details provided where available
license: CC BY 3.0 (imaging under NIH Controlled Data Access)
description: 47 melanoma patients treated with anti-PD-1 immunotherapy with pre-treatment and follow-up PET, CT, and MR imaging, distributed as DICOM under NIH Controlled Data Access.

label_schema: No native per-image segmentation/annotation labels in the core collection (segmentation n/a)
Imaging-modality categories present: MR, CT, PT (PET)
Patient-level clinical metadata digest (Excel) for the 47-subject anti-PD-1 immunotherapy melanoma cohort, with pre-treatment and one or more follow-up imaging timepoints per patient

Tumor lesion annotations / organ segmentations for these cases are NOT in this collection itself; they exist only in the separate related analysis collections Crowds-Cure-2018 (reader-drawn bidirectional lesion measurements) and SAROS (sparsely annotated organ/region CT segmentations)
details.file_structure: Whole-body MR/CT/PET images distributed as DICOM (per-patient study/series folders via the TCIA Data Retriever; 47 subjects, 179 studies, 1,814 series, ~234,113 images, ~98 GB), accompanied by a clinical/metadata digest in Excel (.xlsx); the collection contains no DICOM-SEG or RTSTRUCT objects of its own.
details.extra: Access is via the NIH Controlled Data Access Policy because some images could be used to reconstruct a face; specific clinical/response variable names in the digest Excel could not be verified from the public page and are omitted rather than guessed.

name: Anti-PD-1_Lung
full_name: Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy Lung
protocol_note: FDG PET/CT (modalities PT, CT, SC/OT); pre-treatment and most with 1 follow-up timepoint
size: 61 GB
segmentation_detail: Segmentations available via IDC Zenodo (BAMF AIMI Annotations initiative)
paired_text_detail: Supporting clinical metadata including patient outcomes and treatment details provided where available
description: FDG PET/CT imaging of 46 lung-cancer patients treated with anti-PD-1 immunotherapy, with pre-treatment baseline and follow-up scans.

label_schema: Segmentation masks (not part of original collection; added via BAMF AIMI Annotations initiative)
Primary target: lung nodule / lesion segmentation (nodules 3-30 mm diameter)
Whole-lung segmentation produced as anatomical context; in the combined mask nodules take precedence over lung
Exact integer label values are not documented in the public model card / source, so they are omitted rather than guessed
details.file_structure: Imaging is DICOM CT and PET (modalities PT/CT/SC) organized by TCIA subject/study/series; BAMF-generated segmentations are distributed separately (IDC / Zenodo AIMI community) as DICOM-SEG (.dcm) files, with NIfTI (.nii.gz, e.g. seg_nodules_ensemble / seg_lesions_ensemble) as a fallback format.
details.extra: Segmentations are AI-generated by a BAMF nnU-Net ensemble and validated against a radiologist and a non-expert reviewer; the underlying TCIA collection (46 subjects, pre-treatment plus follow-up FDG PET/CT for anti-PD-1 immunotherapy lung cases) ships no expert tumor annotations of its own.

name: Soft-tissue-Sarcoma
full_name: Soft-tissue-Sarcoma
protocol_note: MRI sequences T1-weighted, T2-weighted fat-saturated, and STIR alongside FDG PET/CT
segmentation_detail: Expert manual GTV_Mass and GTV_Edema tumor contours as RTSTRUCT DICOM objects for all scans
paired_text_detail: Clinical spreadsheet (XLSX): demographics, histopathological type, tumor grade, outcome follow-up (metastases, survival)
description: 51 soft-tissue sarcoma patients with FDG PET/CT and multi-sequence MRI (T1, T2FS, STIR) and expert manual tumor/edema RTSTRUCT segmentations plus clinical outcome data on TCIA.

label_schema: GTV_Mass - gross tumor volume excluding visible peritumoral edema
GTV_Edema - gross tumor volume incorporating visible edema (available for the 32 of 51 patients who had visible edema)
Contours manually drawn by an expert radiation oncologist and propagated across modalities via rigid registration
details.file_structure: 51 patients of pre-treatment FDG-PET/CT and MRI (T1-weighted, T2-weighted fat-saturated, and STIR) stored as DICOM image series, with the GTV_Mass and GTV_Edema tumor contours stored as RTSTRUCT DICOM objects for all scans.
details.extra: 51 patients / 102 studies / 612 series (~38,283 images); 19 patients developed lung metastases during follow-up, and only 32 patients have a GTV_Edema contour since not all tumors showed visible edema.

name: DeepLesion
full_name: NIH DeepLesion
protocol_note: Clinical CT key slices with neighboring slices, 16-bit PNG (HU+32768); contrast phase not specified
size: 32,735 lesions on 32,120 CT slices from 4,427 patients (~225 GB)
license: NIH open access (free for research use)
description: A large-scale CT dataset of 32,735 clinically significant lesions across 4,427 patients, mined from radiologist bookmarks with bounding boxes and RECIST diameter measurements, stored as 16-bit PNG slices.

label_schema: Lesion detection/measurement dataset: each row = one lesion on one key axial CT slice (weak 2D annotation, not full segmentation)
Bounding_boxes: axis-aligned 2D box per lesion (x1,y1,x2,y2), derived from the RECIST measurement
Measurement_coordinates: 8 numbers = the two RECIST diameters (long-axis + short-axis endpoints) marked by radiologists
Lesion_diameters_Pixel_: long and short diameter lengths in pixels
Normalized_lesion_location: relative x,y,z body coordinate of the lesion
Coarse_lesion_type: 8-class lesion category (labeled only for a subset ~9,800 lesions; -1 = unlabeled)
Possibly_noisy flag; plus metadata: Slice_range, Spacing_mm_px_, Image_size, DICOM_windows, Patient_gender, Patient_age
details.file_structure: CT slices are stored as 16-bit unsigned PNG images (intensity = HU + 32768) grouped in folders named by patient_study_series, with a range of slices around each key slice; all annotations are in a single flat CSV file, DL_info.csv, one row per lesion.
details.splits: Official split via the Train_Val_Test column in DL_info.csv (1=train, 2=val, 3=test), an approximately 70/15/15 lesion-level split of the 32,735 lesions.
details.extra: Scale: 32,735 lesions on 32,120 axial CT slices from 10,594 studies of 4,427 unique patients. The Coarse_lesion_type label exists for only a subset of lesions; companion works add richer labels (e.g., LesaNet's 171 RadLex body-part/type/attribute tags text-mined from reports, with 500 test lesions manually annotated by two radiologists).

name: RadImageNet
full_name: RadImageNet
anatomy: Multiple (whole body; CT/MRI/US across many anatomical regions)
protocol_note: Key images from CT (chest, abdomen, pelvis), MRI (ankle, foot, knee, hip, shoulder, brain, spine, abdomen, pelvis) and ultrasound (abdomen, pelvis, thyroid); sequences/phases not specified per image. Commercial site also mentions PET studies.
size: ~1.35 million annotated images from 131,000+ patients (CT, MRI, ultrasound)
segmentation_detail: Image-level pathology labels, not segmentation masks
paired_text_detail: Pathology/anatomy class labels rather than free-text reports or captions
license: RadImageNet license (free for non-commercial research; commercial licensing available)
description: RadImageNet is a large open medical imaging database of ~1.35 million CT, MRI, and ultrasound images with anatomy and pathology labels, built as a domain-specific pretraining resource for transfer learning.

label_schema: Image-level pathologic-finding labels (single class per 'key image'), 165 labels total spanning 3 modalities and 11 anatomies; labels group into musculoskeletal, neurologic, oncologic, gastrointestinal, endocrine, and pulmonary pathology categories (plus 'normal').
CT anatomies (labels within): lung/chest, abdomen, pelvis
MRI anatomies: ankle, foot, knee, hip, shoulder, brain, spine, abdomen, pelvis
NOTE: the exact list of all 165 class names is not published on the official page/paper/GitHub, so individual pathology-class strings cannot be enumerated verified here
details.file_structure: ImageNet-style layout: 2D JPEG 'key images' (~1.35M) sorted into class-named subfolders organized by modality and anatomy; these are image-level classification labels (not segmentation masks), and a dataset train/val/test split is distributed as separate CSV files (linked from the GitHub repo).
details.extra: Curated at a single outpatient facility (2005-2020), 131,872 patients; released primarily as a medical-imaging pretraining corpus with RadImageNet pretrained CNN weights (ResNet50, DenseNet121, InceptionV3, etc.). A region-of-interest localizing each finding was created during annotation but the public release provides image-level labels, not bounding boxes or masks. Full data access is by request at radimagenet.com.

name: PanTS
full_name: PanTS: The Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation Dataset
anatomy: Pancreas (head, body, tail), pancreatic tumors, and 24 surrounding vascular, skeletal, abdominal and thoracic structures
protocol_note: 3D abdominal CT volumes from 145 medical centers; contrast phase not specified on the official page
size: 36,390 3D CT volumes from 145 centers; ~300GB
segmentation_detail: Expert-validated voxel-wise annotations of over 993,000 anatomical structures: pancreatic tumor, pancreas subregions (head/body/tail), and 24 surrounding organs/structures
paired_text_detail: Distributed as paired image-mask-report triplets; radiology reports accompany scans, making it a vision-language dataset
host: GitHub (Johns Hopkins, Zongwei Zhou group); data via download scripts
description: The largest public pancreatic tumor CT dataset (36,390 CT volumes from 145 centers) with voxel-wise annotations of the pancreas, tumors, and 24 surrounding structures plus paired radiology reports.

details.file_structure: Per-case folders named PanTS_XXXXXXXX: CT image as ImageTr|ImageTe/<case>/ct.nii.gz, a radiology report as ReportTr|ReportTe/<case>/report.pdf, and voxel-wise segmentations as LabelTr|LabelTe/<case>/segmentations/<structure>.nii.gz (one separate binary NIfTI mask per structure, e.g. pancreatic_lesion.nii.gz, aorta.nii.gz), with a top-level metadata.xlsx.
details.splits: Official splits: PanTS-tr (training) = 9,000 volumes (IDs from PanTS_00000001); PanTS-te (in-distribution test) = 901 volumes (IDs from PanTS_00009001). The paper also cites external out-of-distribution test sets (UCSF, Polish, Peking University, RSNA) and a full corpus of 36,390 CT volumes from 145 centers.
details.extra: Labels are distributed as one binary mask file per anatomical structure rather than a single multi-label volume; the integer values above come from the official class_map_abdomenatlas_pants map. The 24 'surrounding structures' = the 28 classes minus pancreas, pancreas_body/head/tail subregions, and the pancreatic_lesion tumor.

name: CirrMRI600+
full_name: Large Scale MRI Collection and Segmentation of Cirrhotic Liver
protocol_note: Includes both T1-weighted and T2-weighted abdominal MRI sequences
size: 600+ MRI volumes (T1W and T2W); ~15GB
segmentation_detail: Expert voxel-wise liver segmentation masks (NIfTI) for cirrhotic livers across T1W and T2W volumes
host: Open Science Framework (OSF, osf.io/cuk24); code at GitHub NUBagciLab/CirrMRI600Plus
description: A large public MRI dataset of 600+ T1W and T2W volumes of cirrhotic livers with expert liver segmentation masks for benchmarking segmentation and computer-aided diagnosis.

label_schema: Label 1 - liver (whole cirrhotic liver, single binary foreground mask; models use sigmoid + 0.5 threshold, confirming one foreground class)
details.file_structure: Expert-annotated voxel-wise masks are stored as compressed NIfTI (.nii.gz) with paired filenames across two sibling folders (images/ and labels/, e.g. images/sample_1.nii.gz and labels/sample_1.nii.gz), split by MRI sequence into T1-weighted and T2-weighted volumes.
details.extra: 628 abdominal MRI scans total (310 T1W, 318 T2W) with ~40,000 expert-validated annotated slices; the paper defines train/val/test splits but exact per-modality counts were not confirmed from the abstract/README.

name: Healthy-Total-Body-CTs
full_name: Healthy Total-Body CTs
anatomy: 37 tissues: 13 abdominal organs, 20 bones, subcutaneous and visceral fat, skeletal and psoas muscle
protocol_note: Low-dose whole-body CT from uEXPLORER total-body PET/CT (80-row, 160-slice) acquired before PET at 3 or 6 timepoints (0, 90, 180 min; plus 6, 9, 12 h for 15 subjects). The 90-min scan was 140 kVp, ~50 mAs; all other timepoints were 140 kVp, ~5 mAs. Reconstruction 512x512x828, 0.9766x0.9766x2.344 mm. PET images are not included.
size: 30 healthy adult subjects; 59.03 GB; 111,778 images across 135 series
segmentation_detail: NIfTI segmentations of 37 tissues (13 abdominal organs, 20 bones, subcutaneous/visceral fat, skeletal and psoas muscle) auto-generated with the MOOSE AI whole-body segmentation tool from low-dose whole-body CT
license: Segmentations and clinical data CC BY 4.0; CT images under NIH Controlled Data Access
description: Low-dose whole-body CT scans of 30 healthy adults from a uEXPLORER PET/CT scanner with MOOSE-generated segmentations of 37 tissues plus demographic data, hosted on TCIA.

label_schema: Voxel-wise multi-class segmentation totaling 37 tissue classes (integer label values defined in the accompanying organ-values XLSX key)
13 abdominal organs (e.g. liver, spleen, pancreas, stomach, gallbladder, left/right kidney, left/right adrenal gland, bladder — per MOOSE clin_ct_organs)
20 bones (peripheral/axial skeleton labels from MOOSE, e.g. femur, tibia, fibula, humerus, radius, ulna, pelvis, vertebrae, and additional bone structures)
details.file_structure: CT images are DICOM (organized as 30 studies / 135 series across the 30 subjects and their multiple acquisition timepoints); segmentations are delivered separately as NIfTI (.nii) label maps at the 90-minute timepoint, bundled with an XLSX organ-value key and documentation (segmentations may need re-orientation to align with the DICOM CT).
details.extra: 30 healthy adult subjects; segmentations were auto-generated (not manually verified) with the MOOSE AI whole-body tool (github.com/QIMP-Team/MOOSE) at the 90-min timepoint from low-dose whole-body CT — exact per-class integer indices are specified in the downloadable organ-values spreadsheet.

name: CARE 2024 LiQA
full_name: CARE 2024 Track 3: Liver Fibrosis Quantification and Analysis (LiQA)
protocol_note: Multi-center, multi-vendor (three scanner vendors) liver MRI including T2-weighted, diffusion-weighted, and Gd-EOB-DTPA dynamic contrast sequences across five phases (non-contrast, arterial, venous, delay, hepatobiliary); phases are unregistered and some non-hepatobiliary phases may be randomly missing
size: 440 patients; training 250 (30 with liver segmentation masks + 220 unannotated, all 250 with fibrosis staging labels); test 160 (120 known vendors + 40 unseen vendor)
segmentation_detail: Clinician-verified liver segmentation masks on the hepatobiliary phase for 30 annotated training images; task emphasizes limited-label and domain-shift/generalization settings
description: A multi-center, multi-vendor multi-phase liver MRI challenge dataset of 440 fibrosis patients for hepatobiliary-phase liver segmentation and multi-phase liver fibrosis staging under limited-label and domain-shift conditions.

label_schema: (companion fibrosis-staging subtask target: liver fibrosis stage S1-S4, provided as a per-case categorical label for all 250 training cases)
details.file_structure: Multi-phase Gd-EOB-DTPA liver MRI stored in NIfTI (.nii/.nii.gz) format; the hepatobiliary phase is mandatory per case (other phases - T1WI non-contrast, arterial, venous, delay, plus T2WI and DWI - may be missing), and liver segmentation masks are provided as separate NIfTI label volumes on the hepatobiliary-phase images.
details.splits: Train 250 (only 30 with clinician-verified liver segmentation masks, 220 unannotated); Validation 30 (all annotated); Test 160 (120 from seen vendors + 40 from an unseen vendor for generalization).
details.extra: LiQA (CARE 2024 Track 3) has two subtasks - liver segmentation and liver fibrosis staging - and is designed as a limited-label / domain-shift (multi-vendor) generalization benchmark; segmentation is binary (liver vs. background).

name: VoComni
full_name: VoComni (from Large-Scale 3D Medical Image Pre-training with Geometric Context Priors)
anatomy: 20 organ and tumor classes across whole-body CT (thorax, abdomen, pelvis)
protocol_note: CT volumes aggregated from multiple public CT datasets; acquisition phases not specified.
size: 20,000 CT volumes; ~1.7TB
segmentation_detail: Pseudo-labels for 20 organ and tumor classes, auto-generated across a curated collection of public CT datasets for large-scale pre-training
description: A curated 20,000-volume CT collection with pseudo-labels for 20 organ and tumor classes, released for large-scale 3D medical image pre-training and multi-organ/tumor segmentation.

details.file_structure: nnUNet-style layout: single-channel CT volumes in imagesTr/ named VoComni_{id}_0000.nii.gz with matching integer voxel-value pseudo-label masks in labelsTr/ named VoComni_{id}.nii.gz, all as NIfTI (.nii.gz), plus a VoComni.json descriptor; images are distributed as split tar.gz parts that must be concatenated and extracted.
details.splits: No official train/val/test partition; dataset.json lists numTraining = 20043 volumes (all as a single training pool; a small handful of sample cases are flagged under a 'validation' field for visualization).
details.extra: Labels are model-generated pseudo-labels (produced by the pre-trained VoCo model across a curated collection of public CT datasets) and are explicitly noted to contain noise; the network uses 21 output channels (background + 20 classes). Total download size ~1.7 TB, expanding to ~10 TB.

related.name: Curated collection of public CT datasets (cited in the VoCo TPAMI 2025 paper)
related.note: CT volumes from existing public datasets re-packaged in nnUNet layout with VoCo model-generated pseudo-labels for 20 organ/tumor classes

name: PreCT-160K
full_name: PreCT-160K (Large-Scale 3D Medical Image Pre-training with Geometric Context Priors)
anatomy: Whole-body and various-region CT volumes aggregated from many public CT datasets
protocol_note: Aggregated CT volumes from many public datasets; acquisition phases not specified on the dataset page.
size: ~160,000 CT volumes; ~5.63TB
description: One of the largest open 3D CT collections (~160,000 volumes, 5.63TB in NIfTI) aggregated from many public datasets and curated for large-scale self-supervised medical image pre-training in the VoCo/geometric-context-priors project (TPAMI 2025).

name: RSNA 2023 Abdominal Trauma Detection
full_name: RSNA 2023 Abdominal Trauma Detection Challenge
protocol_note: 1-2 CT series per study (6,481 series / 4,274 studies); protocols biphasic (arterial + portal venous), split-bolus or portal venous; no delayed phase. Phase is not labeled: aortic_hu in the series metadata is the timing proxy (higher = late arterial)
size: ~4,700 patients (multiple CT series each)
segmentation_detail: Organ (liver, spleen, kidney, bowel) and active-extravasation segmentation masks provided for a subset of series
description: A large abdominal CT dataset of ~4,700 trauma patients in DICOM format with organ-level injury grade labels for liver, spleen, kidney and bowel plus organ and active-extravasation segmentation masks for a subset of series.

label_schema: Patient-level classification, one-hot encoded in train.csv (columns per organ):
any_injury (binary; patient-level OR of all injury targets, used for a sample-weight term in the metric)
Slice/image-level labels (image_level_labels.csv): injury_name = 'Active_Extravasation' or 'Bowel', flagging the specific DICOM instances where bowel injury / active extravasation is visible
Organ segmentation masks (NIfTI, provided for a subset of series) integer label values:
details.file_structure: CT volumes are DICOM slices under train_images/{patient_id}/{series_id}/{instance_number}.dcm; patient-level targets are in train.csv, slice-level positive-injury flags in image_level_labels.csv, and per-series metadata (aortic_hu, incomplete_organ) in train_series_meta.csv, while voxel-wise organ segmentation masks are supplied as one NIfTI (.nii) file per series in segmentations/ for only a subset of series.
details.extra: This is a hidden-test code competition (test set not distributed); there is no official train/val split, and the segmentation masks and slice-level injury labels cover only a subset of the training series rather than all of them.
details.label_readers: Initial site labels from clinical reports; solid-organ grades read independently by 3 radiologists (ASER/SAR), majority vote, committee adjudication if all disagree; bowel/mesenteric injury and active extravasation by annotator consensus (bowel reviewed by 2); organ masks from an nnU-Net trained on TotalSegmentator, manually corrected (206 series)
details.reference_standard: Radiologist consensus/majority (AAST-based grades), not surgical confirmation
details.third_party_note: RSNA dataset license (RSNA AI-Challenge-Data wiki / MIRA): non-commercial use only incl. academic research; 'If you share or re-distribute the data in any form, include a citation' — redistribution allowed with citation, no API-specific clause. Kaggle competition-download rules may be stricter.

name: Advanced-MRI-Breast-Lesions
full_name: Standard and Delayed Contrast-Enhanced MRI of Malignant and Benign Breast Lesions with Histological and Clinical Supporting Data
protocol_note: 1.5T breast MRI including T1-weighted dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences (5 time points), T2-weighted images, delayed contrast T1 images (20-28 min post-injection), and treatment response assessment maps (TRAMs).
size: 645.62 GB; 632 imaging sessions (1,259,688 images, 6,811 series)
segmentation_detail: Lesion segmentations manually delineated by a certified radiologist (23 years experience) plus automated thresholding.
paired_text_detail: Clinical/pathology supporting data (XLSX) for 200 patients: patient age, lesion location, malignancy status, pathology grade, receptor status, and Ki67 values.
description: Single-institution retrospective TCIA collection of 632 breast MRI sessions with standard and delayed contrast-enhanced DICOM sequences, lesion segmentations, and histopathology/clinical data for breast cancer diagnosis research.

label_schema: Segmentation: lesion mask (single foreground class) - enhancing/suspicious lesion regions manually delineated by a radiologist then automatically thresholded (subtraction-image intensity > 75)
Clinical/classification (per-patient supporting data, not encoded in the mask): malignant vs benign outcome
Additional clinical fields (for the subset with clinical annotations): patient age, lesion location, pathology and grade, receptor status, Ki67 proliferation index
details.file_structure: TCIA-standard DICOM: MR images (1.5T; multi-time-point T1 DCE, T2 with/without fat suppression, delayed contrast T1, TRAM maps) organized by subject/study/series, lesion annotations delivered as DICOM-SEG segmentation objects, and clinical/supporting data in an XLSX spreadsheet.
details.extra: Collection is 632 breast MRI imaging sessions/subjects (~6,811 series); clinical outcome annotations (malignant/benign, pathology, receptor status, Ki67) are provided for 200 patients. Benign vs malignant is a patient-level clinical label in the spreadsheet, not a class value inside the segmentation objects.

name: Brain-Mets-Lung-MRI-Path-Segs
full_name: MR Imaging and Segmentations with Matched Brain Biopsy Pathology Slides from Patients with Brain Metastases from Primary Lung Cancer
protocol_note: T1-weighted contrast-enhanced (T1CE) and FLAIR sequences, acquired on 0.7T/1.5T/3T scanners (Siemens, GE, Philips, Hitachi).
size: 19.21 GB; 103 patients (111 imaging-pathology pairs)
segmentation_detail: Core tumor / contrast enhancement (107 cases, 96%) and whole tumor with peritumoral edema (104 cases, 94%) segmentations in NIfTI.
paired_text_detail: Clinical/demographic data (smoking history, Karnofsky Performance Status, GPA scores, molecular markers EGFR/ALK/PD-L1) in XLSX, plus 214 extracted radiomic features and matched H&E whole-slide brain biopsy pathology (SVS, 20x).
description: Multimodal TCIA collection pairing pre-operative brain MRI (T1CE and FLAIR) with expert 3D tumor segmentations, matched H&E biopsy whole-slide pathology, and clinical/molecular data for lung-cancer brain-metastasis AI research.

label_schema: Core tumor / contrast enhancement segmentation (binary mask, foreground = enhancing tumor), delineated on T1-weighted contrast-enhanced (T1CE) sequences - present for 107 of 111 pairs (96%)
Whole tumor with peritumoral edema segmentation (binary mask, foreground = tumor + surrounding hyperintense edema), delineated on FLAIR sequences - present for 104 of 111 pairs (94%)
details.file_structure: Segmentations and images are provided as NIfTI files (.nii/.nii.gz) with brain extraction applied; each brain-metastasis resection has up to four files following the naming pattern caseID_t1ce_img, caseID_flair_img, caseID_core_seg, and caseID_whole_seg, hosted on TCIA.
details.extra: Dataset covers 103 unique patients / 111 histologic-radiologic pairs of brain metastases from primary lung cancer; segmentations are paired with pathology, and no official train/validation/test partition is defined.

name: Spine-Mets-CT-SEG
full_name: Spine metastatic bone cancer: pre and post radiotherapy CT (Spine-Mets-CT-SEG)
anatomy: Spine / vertebral column (metastases from breast, lung, prostate, kidney, colon, bladder, sarcoma, and skin primaries)
protocol_note: Radiotherapy simulation CT at Brigham and Women's Hospital on Siemens SOMATOM Confidence and GE Lightspeed; 120 kVp; slice thickness 0.5 mm (SBRT, Siemens), 1.5 mm (other, Siemens), 1.25 mm (GE); in-plane 0.31x0.31 mm; no gating or breath hold. Contrast use not stated.
size: 20.36 GB; 55 patients; 35,582 images across 110 series
segmentation_detail: Manual vertebral segmentation labels created in 3D Slicer plus automated nnU-Net segmentations.
paired_text_detail: Clinical XLSX with demographics, primary cancer type, vertebral involvement, and lesion classification.
description: Pre- and post-radiotherapy spine CT from 55 patients with metastatic bone disease, providing manual and nnU-Net vertebral segmentations and SINS lesion-type classifications.

label_schema: Per-vertebra segmentation masks labeling individual vertebral levels of the spine (cervical/thoracic/lumbar), created and verified manually in 3D Slicer
Automated whole-spine segmentation masks produced by an nnU-Net deep-learning model
Each segmented vertebra is categorized (per the SINS protocol) as one of: Normal, Osteolytic (lytic), Osteosclerotic (blastic), or Mixed lesion
Note: the collection page does NOT publish the integer label-value-to-vertebra/class mapping, so specific segment index values are unconfirmed
details.file_structure: Original CT scans in DICOM plus segmentations in DICOM-SEG format (55 patients, 55 studies, 110 series total), viewable in 3D Slicer with the QuantitativeReporting extension; a helper script (tcia_dcm2nifti.py) is provided to convert DICOM/DICOM-SEG to NIfTI.
details.extra: Vertebral metastases arise from breast, lung, prostate, kidney, colon, bladder, sarcoma, and skin primaries; lesion typing follows the Spinal Instability Neoplastic Score (SINS) framework.

name: CFB-GBM
full_name: Centre Francois Baclesse Glioblastoma (CFB-GBM)
protocol_note: Multiple MR sequences: T1Gd, T1, T1 gradient echo, T2, T2-FLAIR, T2*, and DWI/ADC maps, acquired pre- and post-treatment.
size: 208.01 GB; 264 patients
segmentation_detail: Brain masks and Gross Tumor Volume (GTV) delineations.
paired_text_detail: Clinical data (overall survival, age, gender, height, weight, WHO performance status, demographics), radiotherapy dose (40.05-60 Gy) and fractionation parameters, RANO response scores, and PyRadiomics features provided as TSV.
description: Pre- and post-treatment multi-sequence brain MRI plus CT and radiotherapy dose plans from 264 glioblastoma patients, with GTV segmentations and rich clinical and radiomic data, hosted openly on TCIA.

label_schema: Brain mask (MASK) - binary brain-extraction mask generated with ANTsPyNet-based skull stripping (used for anonymization/defacing)
Gross Tumor Volume (GTV) - binary manual tumor delineation created by radiotherapists in RT treatment planning software (RayStation, Precision, Eclipse) per international guidelines
details.file_structure: DICOM converted to NIfTI (.nii.gz) to strip PHI from headers; each image and each label is a separate volume named [id_patient]_[temporality]_[modality].nii.gz, organized in per-patient / per-timepoint folders, with accompanying TSV spreadsheets for clinical metadata, treatment details, and modality availability.
details.extra: 264 glioblastoma subjects (~208 GB) with longitudinal timepoints (T0/T1/T2); 261 GTV segmentations at baseline (T0), 160 at T1, 122 at T2. Multiple MRI sequences (T1, T1Gd, T1-GE, T2, T2-FLAIR, T2*, ADC/DWI) plus CT and RTDOSE are included; no official train/val/test split is defined - users filter the cohort via the provided spreadsheets.

name: MU-Glioma-Post
full_name: University of Missouri Post-operative Glioma Dataset (MU-Glioma-Post)
protocol_note: Four conventional sequences: T1, T1-gadolinium (T1CE), T2, and FLAIR.
size: 11 GB; 203 patients (596 timepoints)
segmentation_detail: nnU-Net automated tumor segmentation, manually validated by neuroradiologists, with four labels: non-enhancing tumor core, non-enhancing FLAIR hyperintensity, enhancing tissue, and resection cavity.
paired_text_detail: Demographic and clinical data (diagnosis dates, treatment history, disease progression, survival), tumor pathology and genetic mutations, plus segmentation volume and clinical spreadsheets (XLSX).
description: Post-treatment multi-sequence brain MRI from 203 glioma patients across 596 follow-up timepoints (skull-stripped NIfTI) with validated four-label tumor segmentations and clinical data, hosted on TCIA under CC BY 4.0.

label_schema: Label 1 - Non-enhancing Tumor Core (NETC): non-enhancing tumor components such as cystic, necrotic, or hemorrhagic portions
Label 2 - Surrounding Non-enhancing FLAIR Hyperintensity (SNFH): non-enhancing infiltrative tumor and peritumoral vasogenic edema
Label 3 - Enhancing Tissue (ET): viable nodular-enhancing tumor components
Label 4 - Resection Cavity (RC): post-surgical changes including acute blood products/air foci and chronic CSF-isointense material
details.file_structure: NIfTI volumes (converted from source DICOM) organized as one folder per patient (PatientID_XXXX) with per-timepoint subfolders (Timepoint_X); each timepoint holds the co-registered MRI sequences (T1, T1-contrast/T1CE, T2, FLAIR) plus a single multi-label segmentation mask (values 1-4).
details.extra: 203 patients spanning ~596 post-treatment MR timepoints (2,978 series total); tumor segmentations were produced by an automated nnU-Net pipeline and then manually reviewed/validated by neuroradiologists.

name: CMB-CRC
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Colorectal Cancer Collection
protocol_note: Data types: Whole Slide Image, CT, US, PT, MR, NM, DX, XA; standard-of-care longitudinal imaging; sequences/phases/tracers not specified.
size: 400.75 GB; 102 subjects (v11); 62 radiology patients with 269,002 images
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal de-identified clinical and genomic metadata with days-from-enrollment timestamps embedded in DICOM headers, plus matched whole-slide histopathology.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank colorectal-cancer collection with longitudinal de-identified CT/MR/PET radiology plus matched whole-slide pathology and genomic metadata from standard-of-care patients, with a small head-image subset under controlled access.

name: CMB-LCA
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Lung Cancer Collection
protocol_note: Radiology data types listed by TCIA: CT, PT, MR, US, DX, NM (DICOM); MR sequences, CT phases and PET tracers are not specified. Head images (CT, PT, MR) are under NIH controlled access. Whole-slide pathology is provided as SVS with JSON metadata.
size: 421.59 GB total (191.92 GB radiology); 209 subjects
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal de-identified clinical, phenotypic, treatment, and outcome data aligned via temporal markers, plus matched whole-slide histopathology (SVS) and genomic data hosted in dbGaP.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank lung cancer collection on TCIA with longitudinal de-identified CT/PET/MR/radiography imaging (DICOM) plus matched whole-slide pathology and clinical/genomic data (a facial-image head subset is controlled-access).

name: CMB-PCA
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Prostate Cancer Collection
anatomy: Prostate gland (with a small controlled-access head-image subset)
protocol_note: Multiparametric prostate MRI series (e.g., T2-weighted, diffusion) alongside CT and PET/nuclear-medicine imaging.
size: 98.09 GB; 76 subjects (open radiology tier: 26 subjects, ~16.41 GB)
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal clinical metadata with 'days from enrollment' temporal markers in DICOM headers linking scans to clinical events tracked in dbGaP and the NCI Cancer Research Data Commons, plus matched whole-slide histopathology and genomics.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank prostate cancer collection on TCIA with longitudinal de-identified DICOM MR/CT/PET/X-ray imaging plus matched whole-slide pathology and genomics, mostly open under CC BY 4.0 with a small controlled-access head-image subset.

name: CMB-BRCA
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Invasive Breast Carcinoma Collection
protocol_note: Radiology data types listed as MR, CT, MG, US, PT (DICOM); no sequence, phase or tracer details are given. Longitudinal days-from-enrollment are stored in DICOM tag (0012,0052).
size: 203.94 GB total (78.94 GB radiology, 125 GB pathology); 101 subjects
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal de-identified clinical metadata (days-from-enrollment) plus matched whole-slide histopathology and genomic data.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank invasive breast carcinoma collection with de-identified CT, MR, mammography, and PET radiology imaging in DICOM plus matched whole-slide pathology and clinical/genomic metadata.

name: CMB-OV
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Ovarian Carcinoma Collection
protocol_note: MR studies include multiple sequences typical of pelvic/abdominal oncology imaging alongside CT.
size: 36.99 GB radiology (Version 4); 19 radiology subjects, 71 studies, 554 series, 68,415 images; 162 GB histopathology (48 subjects)
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal clinical metadata with 'days from enrollment' timing in DICOM headers, plus matched whole-slide histopathology (SVS) and supporting genomic/phenotypic/clinical data hosted via dbGaP and NCI Cancer Research Data Commons.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank ovarian carcinoma collection on TCIA with de-identified CT and MR DICOM imaging plus matched whole-slide pathology and linked clinical/genomic data.

name: CMB-GEC
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Gastroesophageal Cancer Collection
protocol_note: Open-access radiology: CT, MR, PT (DICOM); head images (PT, CT) under NIH controlled access. Sequences, tracers and contrast phases are not specified.
size: 36.37 GB total (22.13 GB radiology); ~12 open-access radiology subjects, 251 series, 38,709 images
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal de-identified clinical data (days-from-enrollment) plus linked genomic data in complementary NCI databases and matched whole-slide histopathology (controlled access).
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank gastroesophageal cancer collection with de-identified open-access CT/MR/PET DICOM imaging plus linked clinical, genomic, and matched whole-slide pathology data (a small head-imaging subset is controlled-access).

name: CMB-MEL
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Melanoma Collection
anatomy: Melanoma at various body sites (whole-body staging imaging)
protocol_note: Open radiology: CT, US, MR, PT (DICOM); restricted head images CT, PT, MR under NIH Controlled Data Access Policy. Sequences, phases and tracers are not specified.
size: ~46.79 GB open radiology (75,459 DICOM images, 32 subjects); additional 37.94 GB restricted; 155.5 GB histopathology
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal clinical/genomic metadata plus matched whole-slide histopathology (SVS) linked to each subject.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank melanoma collection on TCIA providing de-identified DICOM CT/MR/PET imaging with matched whole-slide pathology and clinical genomic metadata.

name: CMB-AML
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Acute Myeloid Leukemia Collection
anatomy: Acute myeloid leukemia patients; whole-body/staging radiology (CT, MR, angiography, PET) with matched bone marrow histopathology
protocol_note: Open portion: XA, MR, CT DICOM (9 subjects, 16 studies, 52 series, 2,868 images); restricted head imaging: CT, MR, PT (4 subjects, 65 series, 3,704 images) under NIH Controlled Data Access Policy. Sequences, phases and tracers not specified.
size: 448.08 GB, 16 subjects
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal de-identified clinical metadata plus matched whole-slide histopathology and clinical genomics linkage.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank acute myeloid leukemia collection on TCIA with de-identified CT/MR/angiography (and a restricted PET subset) radiology imaging plus matched whole-slide pathology and clinical genomics.

label_schema: Single-cohort diagnosis label: all subjects are Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) patients (Cancer Moonshot Biobank)
NO radiology annotations: no tumor segmentations, RTSTRUCT, or DICOM-SEG for the CT/MR/XA/PT images
Matched histopathology: whole-slide tissue images (.svs) with associated pathology metadata in JSON
Longitudinal timing metadata embedded in DICOM tags (0012,0052)/(0012,0053) as 'days from enrollment/registration', with dates normalized to a 1960 baseline
Genomic, phenotypic, and clinical data hosted separately in dbGaP (controlled access); subset in NCI Cancer Research Data Commons (CRDC)
details.file_structure: Radiology images are de-identified DICOM (CT, MR, XA/angiography, PT/PET) organized per subject in the NBIA/TCIA hierarchy; histopathology is stored as SVS whole-slide images plus JSON pathology metadata; there are no accompanying segmentation/label files for the radiology series.
details.extra: Small, ongoing accruing collection (~16 subjects reported), so counts change over releases; associated clinical/genomic labels require separate dbGaP controlled-access approval rather than being packaged with the images.

name: CMB-MML
full_name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Multiple Myeloma Collection
anatomy: Bone marrow and skeletal system (multiple myeloma); whole-body/skeletal survey imaging, some head/neck coverage
protocol_note: Multiple MR sequences and multimodal PET/CT acquisitions across longitudinal timepoints.
size: 177 subjects; ~50,000 radiology images + 1,071 pathology slides; 6.05 TB
paired_text_detail: Longitudinal clinical metadata with temporal information in DICOM tags, plus matched whole-slide histopathology (SVS) and clinical/genomic data.
description: NCI Cancer Moonshot Biobank multiple myeloma collection on TCIA with de-identified CT, MR, PET, and X-ray (DX/CR/XA) DICOM imaging plus matched whole-slide pathology and clinical/genomic data.

name: SynthRAD2025
full_name: Synthetic CT Generation for Radiotherapy 2025 Challenge
anatomy: Head-and-neck, thorax and abdomen radiotherapy treatment sites
protocol_note: Task 1: paired MRI and planning CT; Task 2: paired CBCT and planning CT; multi-center data acquired on different MRI and CBCT devices and sequences/acquisition settings for head-and-neck, thorax and abdomen.
size: ~900 paired MR-CT cases (Task 1) and ~1500 paired CBCT-CT cases (Task 2) from 5 European university medical centers
description: Second SynthRAD edition providing paired MRI-CT and CBCT-CT volumes across head-and-neck, thorax and abdomen for synthetic-CT generation to enable MRI-only and CBCT-based radiotherapy planning.

label_schema: Reference/target CT (ct.mha) - the ground-truth CT paired with each input image; this is the image-to-image translation target for synthetic-CT (sCT) generation, not a categorical class label
Patient body-outline mask (mask.mha) - a binary mask covering the patient/body region, used to define the ROI for inference and evaluation
NOTE: there are no organ/tissue segmentation classes - the only 'annotation' is the paired ground-truth CT plus the binary body mask
details.file_structure: Per-patient folders (grouped by task and anatomy) each containing the input image (mr.mha for Task 1 MRI-to-CT, or cbct.mha for Task 2 CBCT-to-CT), the reference ct.mha, and a binary mask.mha, all in MetaImage (.mha) format, accompanied by CSV metadata describing acquisition/registration parameters.
details.splits: Approx. 65% train / 10% validation / 25% test per anatomical site; totals ~890 MRI-CT pairs (Task 1) and ~1472 CBCT-CT pairs (Task 2) = 2362 paired sets across head-and-neck, thorax and abdomen (exact per-anatomy counts not confirmed; validation/test ground-truth CTs withheld from participants)
details.extra: Two image-synthesis tasks (MRI->CT and CBCT->CT for radiotherapy dose calculation); multi-center data from five European university hospitals (UMC Groningen, UMC Utrecht, Radboud UMC, LMU Munich, Univ. Hospital Cologne); released on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14918089).

name: TrackRAD2025
full_name: Real-time Tumor Tracking for MRI-guided Radiotherapy 2025
anatomy: Thoracic and abdominal tumors subject to respiratory motion
protocol_note: Time-resolved sagittal 2D cine-MRI from 0.35 T and 1.5 T MRI-linacs, frame rates of 1 to 8 Hz or more; resampled to 1x1 mm in-plane.
size: 585 patients (108 with manual tumor segmentations, 477 unlabeled) from 6 international MRI-linac centers
segmentation_detail: Frame-by-frame manual tumor contours on time-resolved 2D sagittal cine-MRI, stored as <patient_id>_labels.mha
description: Real-time tumor tracking on time-resolved 2D sagittal cine-MRI from 0.35T and 1.5T MRI-linacs, with labeled and unlabeled sequences for supervised and self-supervised motion tracking, released under CC-BY-NC via Grand Challenge and HuggingFace.

label_schema: Binary tumor segmentation mask on each cine-MRI frame (1 = tumor, 0 = background)
Single foreground class: the tumor / target subject to respiratory motion
<patient_id>_first_label.mha - template tumor mask on the first frame only (algorithm input)
<patient_id>_labels.mha - frame-by-frame reference tumor masks for the full sequence (ground truth)
Some cases include per-observer masks (<patient_id>_labels<observer>.mha) reflecting multiple manual annotators
template segmentation on first frame for tracking initialization
details.file_structure: Data is organized per-patient into folders (example/labeled/unlabeled/preliminary/testing), each with an images/ subfolder holding the 2D sagittal cine-MRI sequence as <patient_id>_frames.mha and a targets/ subfolder holding the manual tumor masks (<patient_id>_first_label.mha, <patient_id>_labels.mha); all imaging and label files are MetaImage .mha volumes (16-bit unsigned int, resampled to 1x1 mm in-plane), accompanied by per-case JSON metadata (b-field-strength.json, frame-rate.json, scanned-region.json).
details.splits: Public training: 108 labeled cases plus 477 unlabeled cases; private testing: 8 preliminary/sample cases and 50 final-test cases.
details.extra: Data comes from six international MRI-linac centers at 0.35 T and 1.5 T, released under CC-BY-NC; scanned regions include thorax, abdomen, and pelvis.

name: HECKTOR 2025
full_name: HEad and neCK TumOR segmentation, diagnosis and prognosis 2025
anatomy: Head and neck primary tumors (GTVp) and involved lymph nodes (GTVn)
protocol_note: FDG-PET/CT (co-registered CT and PET NIfTI); Task 2 subset adds radiotherapy planning (dosimetry) CT and RT dose maps for ~187 training / 450 test patients.
size: 1200+ patients from 11+ centers (FDG-PET/CT); ~850 training from prior editions plus ~400 new test cases from two French cohorts
segmentation_detail: Expert segmentations of primary tumor (GTVp) and involved lymph nodes (GTVn) on FDG-PET/CT
paired_text_detail: Structured clinical/EHR data and radiotherapy planning dose maps provided (not free-text reports)
conditions: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
description: HECKTOR 2025 provides 1200+ FDG-PET/CT head-and-neck cases for primary tumor and lymph node segmentation, recurrence-free survival prediction with radiotherapy dose maps, and HPV-status diagnosis.

details.file_structure: Per-patient folders (e.g. CHUM-001) containing co-registered NIfTI .nii.gz volumes named CenterName_PatientID__CT.nii.gz and ...__PT.nii.gz (FDG-PET), with the Task 1 segmentation mask as PatientID.nii.gz (integer labels 0/1/2); Task 2 adds __CTPlanning.nii.gz and __RTDOSE.nii.gz for a subset, and clinical/outcome data is provided in per-task CSV files (e.g. HECKTOR_2025_Training_Task_1.csv).
details.splits: Approximately 700 training cases from 8 centers and approximately 450 test cases from 3 centers (over 1,200 cases across 11 institutions total); no official validation split.
details.extra: The dataset supports three tasks: Task 1 = GTVp/GTVn detection and segmentation on FDG-PET/CT; Task 2 = Recurrence-Free Survival prediction (adds RT planning CT and dose maps); Task 3 = HPV status diagnosis. Contours were manually delineated by an expert radiation oncologist and quality-controlled by a board of 4 experts, following AAPM TG-263 nomenclature.

name: autoPET IV
full_name: autoPET/CT IV - Automated Lesion Segmentation in Whole-Body PET/CT and Longitudinal CT
anatomy: Whole-body tumor lesions (multi-tracer PET/CT) and longitudinal whole-body CT (skull base to mid-thigh) of melanoma patients under therapy
protocol_note: Task 1: whole-body multi-tracer PET/CT (FDG and PSMA), CT resampled to PET resolution, PET in SUV; Task 2: longitudinal whole-body CT (skull base to mid-thigh) of melanoma patients, baseline and follow-up
size: Longitudinal-CT: 300 melanoma patients x 2 timepoints, 57.2 GB; plus multi-tracer whole-body PET/CT cohort from prior autoPET editions
segmentation_detail: Manually annotated voxel-wise malignant tumor lesion segmentation masks by experienced radiologists, plus lesion center-of-gravity coordinates; challenge provides varying annotation levels (full, partial, interactive) for human-in-the-loop segmentation
host: Grand Challenge / FDAT University of Tuebingen (DOI 10.57754/FDAT.qwsry-7t837)
description: Fourth autoPET edition for human-in-the-loop lesion segmentation with varying annotation levels in whole-body multi-tracer PET/CT plus an openly released longitudinal whole-body CT dataset of 300 melanoma patients under therapy.

label_schema: Task 1 (whole-body PET/CT) - binary segmentation mask: 1 = tracer-avid malignant tumor lesion (FDG-avid or PSMA-avid), 0 = background
Task 1 interactive component - pre-simulated foreground clicks (on lesions) and background clicks provided for human-in-the-loop / interactive segmentation
Task 2 (longitudinal whole-body CT, melanoma) - integer-valued instance mask where each positive integer denotes an individual tumor lesion (0 = background)
Task 2 longitudinal correspondence - baseline and follow-up lesions marked as corresponding pairs across the two timepoints
Task 2 interactive component - pre-simulated lesion-center (center-of-gravity) clicks in follow-up scans
details.file_structure: Images and labels are NIfTI (.nii.gz): each PET/CT case has a CT image (resampled to PET resolution), a PET image in SUV units, and a lesion mask (binary for Task 1, integer/instance for Task 2 in Hounsfield-unit CT); challenge submissions must be converted to .mha, and the longitudinal CT training data is distributed via the FDAT repository (DOI 10.57754/FDAT.qwsry-7t837).
details.splits: Task 1 (PET/CT): training = 1,014 FDG studies (501 patients + 513 negative controls) + 597 PSMA studies; preliminary test = 5; final test = 200 (50 FDG LMU, 50 FDG UKT, 50 PSMA LMU, 50 PSMA UKT). Task 2 (longitudinal CT): training = 300 studies/patients (two timepoints each); preliminary test = 5; final test = 140 (70 UKT, 70 University of Mainz).
details.extra: A single lesion class only (no per-lesion-type semantic labels); Task 1 masks are single-reader with radiologist oversight (5-10 yrs experience) while Task 2 was annotated by two experienced radiologists, and 7 corrupted longitudinal cases were noted for correction.

related.name: autoPET I (FDG-PET-CT-Lesions)
related.note: Task 1 FDG PET/CT training data reused from prior autoPET editions

related.name: autoPET III
related.note: Task 1 multi-tracer (FDG+PSMA) training data reused from autoPET III

name: Learn2Reg
full_name: Learn2Reg: Medical Image Registration Challenge
anatomy: Brain (OASIS T1w, hippocampus), lung/thorax (NLST, ThoraxCBCT, COPDGene), abdominal organs (CT and MR), and whole-body PSMA PET/CT
protocol_note: Some tasks provide multiple MR sequences (e.g., T1w and FLAIR in the CuRIOUS task; T1w MR paired with CT in Abdomen MR-CT)
size: Multiple task datasets (e.g., OASIS 416 brain MR scans, extended NLST lung CT, ThoraxCBCT, Abdomen CT-CT 30/20, Abdomen MR-CT, Hippocampus MR 263/131, whole-body PSMA PET/CT ~597 scans)
segmentation_detail: Anatomical structure/organ segmentation labels accompany several registration tasks (e.g., 13 abdominal organ labels, 35 OASIS brain labels, lung structures) for evaluation
license: CC BY (task-dependent; e.g. ThoraxCBCT CC BY 3.0, extended NLST CC BY 4.0)
host: Grand Challenge / Zenodo / institutional cloud (Uni Luebeck)
description: A multi-task medical image registration benchmark providing openly downloadable CT, MRI, and PSMA-PET/CT datasets in NIfTI format with organ segmentation labels, anatomical landmarks, and displacement-field evaluation.

label_schema: Learn2Reg is a MULTI-TASK deformable image-registration benchmark; several sub-datasets ship voxelwise anatomical SEGMENTATION masks (integer-labeled NIfTI) used only for evaluation (Dice) and optional weak supervision, plus keypoints/landmarks on others.
--- Abdomen CT-CT (Task3, from BTCV/Multi-Atlas Beyond-Cranial-Vault): 13 organ labels ---
Label 10 - portal vein and splenic vein

--- OASIS brain MRI (inter-subject T1w): 35 cortical/subcortical structure labels from automatic FreeSurfer + SAMSEG segmentation (e.g. left/right cerebral white matter and cortex, lateral ventricle, cerebellum WM/cortex, thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, accumbens, ventral DC, brain stem, CSF, choroid plexus); exact per-integer mapping follows the FreeSurfer LUT but was not confirmed value-by-value here.
--- Hippocampus MRI (Task4): hippocampus segmentation, 2 labels (hippocampus head/anterior and body+tail/posterior).
--- Abdomen MR-CT (Task1 2021): 4 labels on training data (liver, spleen, left kidney, right kidney), expanded label set on test.
--- Lung CT / NLST / ThoraxCBCT / COPDGene: binary lung mask segmentations plus manual/automatic keypoint landmark correspondences (used as the primary metric, TRE); no multi-organ class labels.
--- CuRIOUS / ReMIND (MRI-ultrasound): matched anatomical LANDMARKS only, no segmentation classes.
--- LUMIR (2024/25 brain, unsupervised): held-out evaluation uses a large ~130-region brain parcellation label set + landmarks (labels not exposed to participants).
--- PSMAReg (2026 whole-body PET/CT) and Learn2Breath (2026 lung): registration tasks with masks/landmarks; organ-class label lists not published on the page.
details.file_structure: Data are distributed per sub-task as a downloadable bundle with a dataset JSON descriptor; 3D images and their label maps are stored as compressed NIfTI (.nii.gz) in parallel folders (e.g. imagesTr/labelsTr, keypointsTr, masksTr) with paired fixed/moving filenames, where label files are integer-valued segmentation volumes co-registered to the images (landmark/keypoint tasks add .csv/.txt point files instead of dense labels).
details.splits: Per-task (official train/test, no separate public val labels for most): Abdomen CT-CT 30 train / 20 test (13 labels); OASIS ~416 train / 39 test (35 labels); Hippocampus MR 263 train / 131 test (2 labels); Abdomen MR-CT 8 paired train / 8 test (+90 unpaired); Lung CT 20 train / 10 test; CuRIOUS 22 train / 10 test. Newer editions differ (NLST/ThoraxCBCT 2022; LUMIR 2024/25; PSMAReg 597 scans-378 pts train-val / 262 scans-131 pts test and Learn2Breath 200 train / 10 val / 100 test in 2026).
details.extra: This is a registration challenge, not a segmentation challenge: segmentation labels exist mainly to compute Dice/HD95 overlap of warped structures and (optionally) for weak supervision; the abdominal 13-label and OASIS 35-label schemas are the most commonly cited, and the classic 2020/2021 tasks are the ones with dense multi-organ labels.

related.note: T1w brain MRI preprocessed with FreeSurfer/SAMSEG labels for inter-subject registration
