name: ODELIA Breast MRI 2025
full_name: ODELIA Breast MRI Classification Challenge 2025
protocol_note: Each study includes a T2-weighted acquisition and a DCE acquisition with one pre-contrast and 2-7 post-contrast phases
size: 500 studies (~135GB) from six European centers, multiple vendors at 1.5T and 3T
description: Multi-center European breast MRI challenge with T2 and multi-phase DCE studies (NIfTI) for three-way classification of scans as no lesion, benign, or malignant, hosted on Hugging Face under a non-commercial data usage agreement.

label_schema: Per-breast classification into 3 classes: non-lesion (no lesion), benign, malignant
Labels stored as the 'Lesion_Left' and 'Lesion_Right' columns (default bilateral config) or a single 'Lesion' column (unilateral config)
Task is weakly-supervised image-level classification of malignancy (no pixel/voxel segmentation masks are provided)
lesion classification: no lesion / benign / malignant
details.file_structure: Downloaded per institution as Institution/data/<UID>/ (or data_unilateral/) holding NIfTI volumes (Pre.nii.gz, Post_1.nii.gz, ... dynamic contrast sequences) plus Institution/metadata/annotation.csv (UID, PatientID, Institution, Age, Lesion_Left/Lesion_Right or Lesion) and split.csv (UID, Split, Fold).
details.splits: Default (bilateral) config: 472 train / 119 val / 150 test. Unilateral config: 944 train / 238 val / 300 test. split.csv also provides a Fold column for cross-validation.
details.extra: The RSH institution subset is designated an out-of-distribution benchmark and is excluded from the train/val/test sets. Dataset is gated on Hugging Face (requires access request).

name: Deep-PSMA
full_name: DEEP-PSMA: Deep-learning Evaluation for Enhanced Prognostics - PSMA and FDG PET/CT
anatomy: Whole-body tumor lesions in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, with paired dual-tracer PSMA and FDG PET/CT
protocol_note: Dual-tracer paired imaging per patient: Ga-68/18F PSMA PET/CT and 18F-FDG PET/CT, each with co-registered CT
size: 100 training patients (~24.1 GB, NIfTI, on Zenodo); challenge also includes 10 preliminary validation and 40 test cases; single center (Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre)
segmentation_detail: Expert whole-body tumor lesion segmentations on paired PSMA and FDG PET/CT with physiologic-uptake exclusion; NIfTI label masks
description: Whole-body tumor-burden segmentation dataset of paired dual-tracer PSMA PET/CT and FDG PET/CT for 100 mCRPC patients with expert lesion segmentations, openly released in NIfTI on Zenodo (CC-BY-NC-4.0).

label_schema: Primary annotation target: TTB.nii.gz = Total Tumour Burden binary mask (Label 1 = malignant tumor lesion voxel; 0 = background), provided SEPARATELY for the PSMA study and for the FDG study

TTB is derived by SUV thresholding then manually curated by expert nuclear-medicine physicians to distinguish malignant lesions from physiologic tracer uptake (physiologic-uptake regions such as liver, kidneys, brain, bladder, salivary glands are excluded from the mask)
threshold.json = per-study SUV threshold used for labelling (PSMA: uniform SUV >= 3; FDG: variable liver-based threshold, ~2.5-5, generally liver mean + 2*SD)
totseg_24.nii.gz = auxiliary organ reference masks from TotalSegmentator (24-organ output), provided as anatomical context / physiologic-exclusion reference, not the segmentation target
details.file_structure: NIfTI (.nii.gz); each case is a folder train_XXXX containing two subfolders PSMA/ and FDG/, and each subfolder holds CT.nii.gz, PET.nii.gz (SUV units), TTB.nii.gz (tumor label), totseg_24.nii.gz (organ masks), threshold.json (SUV threshold), and rigid.tfm (PET/CT registration transform).
details.splits: 100 training patients, 10 preliminary validation cases, 40 held-out final test cases (test labels withheld).
details.extra: Dual-tracer paired study: each patient has both PSMA PET/CT (68Ga-PSMA-617 or 18F-DCFPyL) and FDG PET/CT, with independent TTB masks for each tracer; metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer cohort from Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre.

name: BONBID-HIE 2024
full_name: 2nd BOston Neonatal Brain Injury Dataset for Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy - Outcome Prediction and Lesion Segmentation
protocol_note: Skull-stripped ADC (apparent diffusion coefficient) maps and Z-ADC (normalized ADC) maps derived from neonatal brain diffusion MRI
size: Labeled MGH cohort (~133 patients on base record) plus unlabeled BCH cohort; 44 test cases (Track 1 segmentation), 53 test cases (Track 2 outcome prediction), 4 validation cases per track
segmentation_detail: Manual expert HIE lesion segmentation masks on neonatal brain diffusion MRI (ADC/Z-ADC); lesions are often diffuse and very small (>50% of patients have lesions <1% of brain volume)
description: Second BONBID-HIE edition providing openly downloadable neonatal-brain diffusion MRI ADC and Z-ADC maps (MHA format) with manual HIE lesion segmentation masks and binary neurodevelopmental outcome labels for lesion segmentation and outcome prediction.

label_schema: Track 1 (segmentation) - binary voxel-wise HIE lesion mask: value 1 = lesion (hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy), value 0 = background/normal brain tissue
Track 2 (classification/outcome prediction) - subject-level binary 2-year neurodevelopmental outcome label: 1 = adverse outcome, 0 = normal outcome
details.file_structure: Per-subject 3D volumes stored as .mha (MetaImage/SimpleITK) files organized into modality folders - skull-stripped ADC maps (1ADC_ss), Z-score normalized ADC maps (2Z_ADC), and the expert binary lesion label masks (3LABEL); the outcome/classification target is provided separately as tabular metadata.
details.splits: Total 133 HIE patients (2023 release with expert lesion annotations). 2024 challenge: a 4-case validation subset (for sanity-check submissions) plus a hidden test set of 44 cases for Track 1 (segmentation) and 53 cases for Track 2 (outcome prediction); remaining annotated MGH cases plus additional BCH data form the training set (exact per-track training counts not published).
details.extra: Lesions are frequently diffuse and very small - over 50% of patients have lesions occupying <1% of brain volume - making this a highly class-imbalanced segmentation task; annotations were produced by expert clinicians. Data hosted on Zenodo (records 8104103 and 10602767).

related.name: BONBID-HIE
related.note: 2024 challenge reuses the BONBID-HIE ADC/Z-ADC data and lesion masks, adding 2-year outcome labels and BCH data

name: ToothFairy3
full_name: ToothFairy3: Multi-Class Segmentation in CBCT Volumes
anatomy: Maxillofacial / dental structures (teeth, mandible, maxillary bone, pharynx, pulp cavities, incisive nerves, lingual foramen, inferior alveolar canal)
protocol_note: Cone Beam CT volumes of the maxillofacial region, stored in Hounsfield Units at 0.3 mm isotropic voxel spacing
size: Publicly annotated CBCT scans with 77 anatomical classes (expanded from ToothFairy2's 42)
segmentation_detail: Dense multi-class labels for 77 maxillofacial structures including teeth, mandible, maxillary bone, pharynx, pulp cavities, incisive nerves, lingual foramen and inferior alveolar canal
description: Third ToothFairy edition (MICCAI 2025) providing publicly released CBCT volumes with dense annotations for 77 maxillofacial classes, featuring a runtime-aware multi-class segmentation task and a click-based interactive inferior-alveolar-canal segmentation track.

label_schema: Labels 11-18 - Upper Right teeth in FDI notation (11 Central Incisor, 12 Lateral Incisor, 13 Canine, 14 First Premolar, 15 Second Premolar, 16 First Molar, 17 Second Molar, 18 Third Molar/Wisdom)
Labels 21-28 - Upper Left teeth (same FDI ordering, Central Incisor through Third Molar)
Labels 31-38 - Lower Left teeth (Central Incisor through Third Molar)
Labels 41-48 - Lower Right teeth (Central Incisor through Third Molar)
Labels 111-118, 121-128, 131-138, 141-148 - per-tooth Pulp cavities (one pulp label per FDI tooth; collapsed to a single combined Pulp class = 150 during evaluation)
details.file_structure: nnU-Net dataset format: NIfTI volumes (.nii.gz) in image/label subfolders with a dataset.json defining the 77 foreground classes; CBCT scans stored in Hounsfield Units at 0.3 mm isotropic voxel spacing (challenge inference/submission uses .mha).
details.splits: Public training data totals 532 CBCT volumes (Set A = 417, Set B = 63, Set C = 52); the test set is hidden on the Grand Challenge platform and its count is not published.
details.extra: The 77 foreground classes decompose as 10 anatomical/dental structures (jaws, canals, sinuses, pharynx, bridge, crown, implant) + 32 teeth (FDI notation) + 3 nerve canals (2 incisive + lingual) + 32 per-tooth pulp cavities; teeth are labeled with their literal two-digit FDI numbers. Data is CC-BY-NC-SA licensed and requires registration to download.

name: TopBrain 2025
full_name: TopBrain: Whole Brain Vessel Anatomy Segmentation Challenge
anatomy: Whole-brain arterial and venous vasculature (major arteries and veins)
protocol_note: Paired CTA and MRA acquisitions provided per subject (25 CTA/MRA pairs in released batches)
size: Batches 1-2 on Zenodo: 50 angiographic scans (25 paired CTA/MRA subjects), ~2.0 GB; 40 CTA / 42 MRA vessel labels (34 overlapping)
segmentation_detail: Topology-aware multi-class voxel labeling of 40+ named brain vessel segments (arteries and veins) on CTA and MRA, with ITK-SNAP labelmap files provided
license: Open use with attribution (commercial use requires permission from data owner)
description: MICCAI 2025 challenge providing openly released paired CTA and MRA brain volumes in NIfTI with 40+ named arterial and venous vessel labels for topology-aware whole-brain vessel segmentation.

label_schema: Multi-class voxel segmentation of named brain vessel segments; labels 1-34 are shared (mutual) between CTA and MRA, with modality-specific labels added on top (CTA total 40, MRA total 42). Shared labels 1-34:

CTA-specific venous/sinus labels: Label 35 - Vein of Galen; Label 36 - Straight sinus; Label 37 - Internal cerebral veins; Label 38 - Right basal vein of Rosenthal; Label 39 - Left basal vein of Rosenthal; Label 40 - Superior sagittal sinus

MRA-specific external-carotid labels: Label 35 - Right external carotid artery; Label 36 - Left external carotid artery; Label 37 - Right superficial temporal artery; Label 38 - Left superficial temporal artery; Label 39 - Right maxillary artery; Label 40 - Left maxillary artery; Label 41 - Right middle meningeal artery; Label 42 - Left middle meningeal artery
details.file_structure: Images and multi-class masks are stored as NIfTI (.nii.gz, 16-bit signed, LPS+ orientation) in modality-split folders (imagesTr_topbrain_ct/mr and labelsTr_topbrain_ct/mr) with filenames like topcow_{modality}_{patID}_0000.nii.gz, accompanied by ITK-SNAP label-map .txt files (itksnap_labelmap_txt) mapping integer values to anatomy names.
details.splits: Public training release ~25 subjects (images + annotations); hidden test set ~20 subjects (TopCoW internal test, not publicly released).
details.extra: Labels 1-12 and 15 are inherited directly from the TopCoW Circle-of-Willis annotation scheme; the CTA and MRA tracks share 34 mutual labels, and the vessel set spans major arteries plus (CTA) major veins/dural sinuses.

name: CURVAS-PDAC
full_name: Calibration and Uncertainty for multiRater Volume Assessment - Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma Vascular Invasion
anatomy: Pancreas (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma) and peripancreatic vasculature (Porta, SMV, Aorta, Celiac Trunk, SMA)
protocol_note: Upper-abdominal axial, portal-venous contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) selected from a subset of the PANORAMA challenge dataset; CT scans standardized to head-first orientation in the updated release.
size: Training set: 40 contrast-enhanced abdominal CT cases (of a 125-scan cohort; validation=5, test=85 withheld); ~5.5 GB; each case has 5 PDAC segmentations plus STAPLE consensus and vessel annotations
segmentation_detail: Multi-rater segmentations: five PDAC tumor annotations per case (one from PANORAMA plus four additional radiologists), STAPLE consensus label, and vascular structure masks (Porta, SMV, Aorta, Celiac Trunk, SMA) for uncertainty quantification
description: A multi-rater contrast-enhanced abdominal CT dataset of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and peripancreatic vessels providing five per-case segmentations plus STAPLE consensus for calibration-aware segmentation, uncertainty quantification, and vascular-invasion/resectability assessment.

label_schema: PDAC tumor - STAPLE consensus (binary label fused from the 5 annotations)
Vascular mask Label 2 - SMV (superior mesenteric vein)
Vascular mask Label 5 - SMA (superior mesenteric artery)
details.file_structure: Per-case folders each containing a CT volume (image.nii.gz), five binary tumor annotations (annotation_1..5.nii.gz), a STAPLE consensus tumor mask (annotation_staple.nii.gz), and a multi-label peripancreatic vascular mask (Porta/SMV/Aorta/Celiac Trunk/SMA = 1..5), all as compressed NIfTI (.nii.gz).
details.splits: 40 training CT scans, 5 validation CT scans, and 80 test CT scans (some complex cases excluded); test labels are hidden.
details.extra: Designed for uncertainty quantification: the five independent PDAC annotations come from radiologists at Universitatsklinikum Erlangen, Hospital de Sant Pau, and Hospital de Mataro, and the CT volumes were standardized to head-first orientation in the updated Zenodo release.

related.name: PANORAMA
related.note: 125 portal-venous CECT scans with pathology-confirmed PDAC selected from PANORAMA; four extra radiologist tumour annotations, STAPLE consensus and peripancreatic vessel masks added

name: FLARE-Task4-CT-FM
full_name: MICCAI FLARE 2025 Task 4: Foundation Models for 3D CT
anatomy: Whole-body / assorted anatomical regions on 3D CT, with abdominal and lung downstream validation tasks
size: 10,000+ 3D CT volumes (807 GB)
segmentation_detail: Pretraining corpus is unlabeled; downstream validation sets include abdominal organ/lesion and lung lesion segmentation tasks, but no annotations are provided for the pretraining volumes
description: Official MICCAI FLARE 2025 Task 4 large-scale unlabeled 3D CT dataset (10,000+ volumes, 807 GB) for pretraining CT imaging foundation models, with abdominal and lung downstream validation tasks.

label_schema: Pretraining corpus (train_part1 + train_part2, 10,000+ 3D CT volumes): NO annotations provided - raw images only (challenge rule: public annotations may NOT be used during pretraining)
Downstream validation labels live only under val_downstream/, split into 4 task folders:
abdomen_disease_classify - Abdominal disease multi-label classification (evaluated by mean Average Precision / mAP)
abdomen_organ_seg - Abdominal organ segmentation (multi-class organ masks; per-class integer indices not publicly listed - dataset is gated)

Segmentation tasks evaluated by Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) and Normalized Surface Distance (NSD); exact organ/lesion class names and label integer values are not confirmable from the public (gated) page

name: FLARE-Task4-MRI-FM
full_name: MICCAI FLARE 2025 Task 4: Foundation Models for 3D MRI
anatomy: Assorted anatomical regions across many MRI sequences: brain, heart/myocardium, and liver, plus other body regions in the large unlabeled pretraining pool
protocol_note: Multiple MRI sequences spanning brain, cardiac, and abdominal (liver) imaging aggregated from public repositories
size: 10,000+ unlabeled 3D MRI volumes for pretraining, plus smaller labeled downstream sets
segmentation_detail: Pretraining data is unlabeled (raw images only); downstream tasks include liver tumor segmentation and cardiac/heart structure segmentation
license: Mixed: CC0 1.0 / CC BY 4.0 for pretraining data, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for downstream tasks
description: Official MICCAI FLARE 2025 Task 4 dataset providing 10,000+ unlabeled 3D MRI volumes for imaging foundation-model pretraining, plus labeled brain, cardiac, and liver downstream benchmark tasks.

label_schema: PRETRAINING POOL (train/): 10,000+ raw MRI scans with NO annotations — raw images only; challenge rules forbid using any public annotations during pretraining
ATLAS23_liver_tumor_seg (segmentation, CE-T1 liver MRI): liver and liver-tumor masks — per the source ATLAS dataset convention Label 1 = liver, Label 2 = liver tumor (background 0)

EMIDEC_heart_seg_and_class (segmentation, cardiac delayed-enhancement MRI): myocardial contours, infarcted area, and permanent microvascular obstruction (no-reflow) — per source EMIDEC convention 0 = background, 1 = LV cavity/blood pool, 2 = normal myocardium, 3 = myocardial infarction, 4 = no-reflow/PMO
EMIDEC_heart_seg_and_class (classification): binary — normal vs pathological heart
ABIDEII_classification: binary — autism spectrum disorder vs neurotypical (brain MRI)
openneuro_NeuropsychiatricPhenomics_classification: phenotypic diagnostic classification (multi-/binary class; exact label set not disclosed on page)
openneuro_ds004856_regression: brain age prediction — continuous age in years
UPenn_GBM_regression: glioblastoma survival prediction — continuous survival outcome (concordance-index metric)
details.file_structure: Root splits into train/ (10,000+ unlabeled pretraining MRIs) and val_downstream/ with one subfolder per downstream task; imaging is volumetric MRI (NIfTI) with segmentation tasks providing paired label masks and classification/regression tasks providing tabular labels — the official test sets are withheld to prevent data leakage.
details.splits: Pretraining: 10,000+ unlabeled scans (train/). Downstream (train/val, test withheld): ATLAS23 liver tumor 60 (40/20); EMIDEC heart 60 (40/20); ABIDEII autism 317 (253/64); NeuropsychiatricPhenomics 261 (148/113); ds004856 brain age 600 (480/120); UPenn_GBM survival 452 (361/91).
details.extra: This is a MICCAI FLARE 2025 Task 4 MRI foundation-model benchmark: the large train/ pool is deliberately annotation-free for self-supervised pretraining, and generalization is evaluated across the 6 heterogeneous downstream tasks (2 segmentation, 2 classification, 2 regression). Exact segmentation integer indices are not published on the gated HF page; the values listed follow the canonical original ATLAS and EMIDEC label conventions and should be confirmed against the downloaded masks.

name: IMed-361M
full_name: IMed-361M: Interactive Medical Image Segmentation Benchmark Dataset
anatomy: Multi-organ and whole-body structures across 14 imaging modalities (multi-anatomy)
protocol_note: 14 modalities per entry: CT, CTA, MR, MR-CMR, MR-FLAIR, MR-T1W, MR-T2W, MR-TOF, MR-T1GD, Ultrasound, X-Ray, Fundus, Dermoscopy, Endoscopy.
size: 287 GB; ~6.4M image-mask pairs with 361 million masks
segmentation_detail: 361 million interactive segmentation masks paired with medical images, aggregated and standardized from 100+ public datasets (e.g. BraTS, AMOS, ACDC, ATLAS); supports point/bbox/mask interactive prompting
description: A 287GB benchmark of ~6.4M medical images with 361 million interactive segmentation masks spanning CT, MRI, PET, X-ray and other modalities, aggregated from 100+ public datasets.

label_schema: Dense interactive pixel-level segmentation masks (not a single fixed class-index map). Per image there are two annotation layers:

(1) Ground-truth semantic masks: 204 distinct segmentation targets aggregated from 110+ source datasets, spanning 6 anatomical/target groups (head & neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, bone/limb, and lesions). Each image's GT is stored as one-hot encoding (one channel per class present), so labels are multi-class per image rather than a fixed global integer palette.

(2) Interactive masks: 273.4M automatically generated component/region masks (avg ~56 per image) used for point-click / bounding-box / text interactive prompting. Totals: ~87.6M GT masks + 273.4M interactive masks = 361M masks over 6.4M images.
Covered across 14 modalities: CT, CTA, MR, MR-CMR (cardiac), MR-FLAIR, MR-T1W, MR-T2W, MR-TOF, MR-T1GD (T1 gadolinium), Ultrasound (US), X-Ray, Fundus, Dermoscopy, Endoscopy.

NOTE: the specific 204 target names / integer values are not enumerated on the public card; the exact per-class mapping lives in each source dataset's dataset.json rather than a single global index list.
details.file_structure: Standardized per-source-dataset folders (e.g. BTCV/, BraTS2021/, ACDC/, AMOS/) each containing image/ (2D slices as PNG), label/ (ground-truth one-hot masks as compressed .npz in CSR sparse format), imask/ (interactive masks as .npy), and a dataset.json metadata file; 3D volumes are pre-sliced along the volume dimension into 2D PNG/npz pairs, and the full set is distributed on Hugging Face as per-dataset .zip archives.
details.splits: 90% train / 10% test per source dataset (3D volumes split along the volume dimension); the held-out test set contains 58,411 images with the same modality/target distribution as the full set. No separate official validation split.
details.extra: Aggregated and standardized from 110+ public datasets (BraTS, AMOS, ACDC, ATLAS, KiTS, BTCV, MSD, FLARE, etc.); annotations are fine-grained (most masks cover <2% of image area) and interactive masks were auto-generated with a vision foundation model plus quality control. Paper: arXiv 2411.12814; code: uni-medical/IMIS-Bench.

name: MedVision
full_name: MedVision: Unified Medical Image Understanding Dataset
anatomy: Multi-organ across 22 aggregated public datasets (brain, heart, kidney/abdomen, knee, head/neck, dental, fetal brain, whole body)
protocol_note: Includes multi-parametric/multi-sequence MRI sources such as BraTS24 and SKM-TEA
size: 29K 3D images / 11.2M 2D slices (~1TB complete)
segmentation_detail: Segmentation masks plus landmark coordinates, bounding boxes, and quantitative measurements (tumor/lesion size, distance, angle) harmonized from 22 aggregated datasets (BraTS24, KiTS23, AMOS22, ACDC, OAIZIB-CM, Ceph-Bio-400, autoPET-III, etc.)
description: A large unified medical imaging dataset aggregating 22 public CT/MRI/PET/X-ray collections with segmentation, detection, landmark, and quantitative measurement annotations for medical image understanding.

label_schema: MedVision is a harmonized 2D-slice aggregation of 22 public datasets; labels are organized by ANNOTATION TYPE rather than one universal class list, encoded in the config name as {dataset}_{annotation-type}_{task-ID}_{slice-plane}_{split}

MaskSize (segmentation): per-instance segmentation masks referenced by 'mask_file'; class semantics come from the source dataset (e.g. BraTS24 tumor sub-regions, KiTS23 kidney/tumor/cyst, AMOS22/BCV15/TotalSegmentator multi-organ, ACDC cardiac structures, OAIZIB-CM knee bone/cartilage) - no single cross-dataset integer->class map is defined
BoxSize (detection): bounding boxes derived from masks, stored as sequences of 'min_coords', 'max_coords', 'center_coords', 'dimensions', and 'sizes'
TumorLesionSize: ellipse-fitted tumor/lesion measurements (major/minor axis) computed from lesion masks

BiometricsFromLandmarks (regression/measurement): angle and distance metrics computed from landmark coordinates ('landmark_file'), stored as 'metric_type', 'metric_value', 'metric_unit' (e.g. cephalometric angles/distances in Ceph-Bio-400)

22 source datasets: AbdomenAtlas, AbdomenCT-1K, ACDC, AMOS22, autoPET-III, BCV15, BraTS24, CAMUS, Ceph-Bio-400, CrossMoDA, FeTA24, FLARE22, HNTSMRG24, ISLES24, KiPA22, KiTS23, MSD, OAIZIB-CM, SKM-TEA, ToothFairy2, TopCoW24, TotalSegmentator
details.file_structure: Hosted on Hugging Face as parquet-backed configs named {dataset}_{annotationType}_{taskID}_{slicePlane}_{split}; each row is a 2D slice with metadata and pointers to per-instance 'mask_file' (segmentation), 'landmark_file' (coordinates), or inline box/measurement fields, with raw source volumes (NIfTI/.nii.gz, NRRD/MHA) auto-downloaded and sliced by the provided loading script.
details.splits: Each config carries a Train or Test split (no separate val); aggregate scale reported as ~29K 3D images -> ~11.2M 2D slices with tens of millions of annotations, but no single official per-class train/val/test count table.
details.extra: Not a single fixed-schema benchmark: it is a slice-level harmonization layer over 22 heterogeneous datasets, so segmentation class names/indices must be taken from each constituent source dataset rather than a unified MedVision label map.

18 clinical VQA task types (e.g. disease diagnosis, anatomy/organ recognition, lesion/attribute recognition, modality recognition, severity grading, counting, microorganism recognition, muscle/nervous/blood-vessel recognition, region/superclass identification)
18 clinical departments (e.g. radiology, ophthalmology, dermatology, pathology, oral/dental, orthopedics, gastroenterology, pulmonology, cardiology, etc.)
4 perceptual granularities (image-level, box-level, mask/contour-level, point-level) describing annotation detail from which each question was generated
