name: Pretreat-MetsToBrain-Masks
full_name: Pre-treatment MRI with Brain Metastases Masks (Yale)
protocol_note: T1, T1 post-gadolinium (MPRAGE), T2, FLAIR; preprocessed and registered to SRI24 template at 1mm isotropic
size: 200 subjects (1000 studies), 1.7 GB
segmentation_detail: Manual NIfTI masks of tumor core, necrosis, and whole tumor including sub-centimeter metastases, verified/approved by two neuroradiologists
description: Multi-parametric pre-treatment brain MRI (T1, T1-post-Gd, T2, FLAIR) from 200 patients with expert NIfTI segmentation masks of brain metastases including many sub-centimeter lesions, openly available on TCIA.

label_schema: Core (enhancing) tumor - segmented on T1 post-gadolinium
Whole tumor - segmented on FLAIR (includes sub-centimeter metastases)
Clinical metadata (demographics, survival outcomes) as spreadsheet
details.file_structure: Per-patient NIfTI files: four co-registered MRI sequences (T1w, T1 post-gadolinium, T2w, FLAIR) plus manual segmentation masks in native space, the three tumor components combined into a single mask NIfTI; segmentations were performed on DICOM in research PACS and checked/corrected in ITK-SNAP.
details.extra: 200 subjects (~1,000 studies) with brain metastases from breast cancer, small-cell and non-small-cell lung cancer, and melanoma; all segmentations manually performed and approved by two neuroradiologists. Integer label values are not explicitly stated on the official TCIA page.

name: APIS
full_name: A Paired CT-MRI Dataset for Ischemic Stroke Segmentation
protocol_note: Paired skull-stripped non-contrast CT (NCCT) co-registered with ADC/DWI brain MRI
size: 100 studies (60 train / 40 test)
segmentation_detail: Ischemic lesion masks delineated on ADC by two independent neuroradiologists
description: Paired non-contrast CT and ADC/DWI brain MRI studies with expert ischemic stroke lesion masks for cross-modality acute stroke segmentation.

label_schema: Label 1 - acute ischemic stroke lesion (single foreground class; lesion tissue delineated on ADC by two independent neuroradiologists, co-registered to NCCT)
details.file_structure: Paired volumetric studies per patient (NCCT + ADC) with a single binary ischemic-lesion mask, distributed as NIfTI volumes accessible upon registration; the lesion is delineated on ADC and the mask is co-registered to the NCCT for training.
details.splits: Train: 60 paired NCCT-ADC cases with expert lesion annotations; Test/validation: 40 cases (100 total).
details.extra: APIS (ISBI 2023 challenge) is described as the first paired public dataset with NCCT and ADC studies of acute ischemic stroke; lesions show high variability in shape, size, and number of affected slices, and NCCT-only segmentation remained very challenging for submitted methods.

name: SynthRAD2023
full_name: Synthesizing Computed Tomography for Radiotherapy 2023
protocol_note: Task 1: paired MRI-CT; Task 2: paired CBCT-CT. Brain and pelvis cases from three Dutch centers (UMC Utrecht, UMC Groningen, Radboud Nijmegen) with heterogeneous MRI sequences and acquisition settings. Per the dataset paper, brain MRI is mainly T1-weighted, partly contrast-enhanced, and pelvic MRI is T1-/T2-weighted. Planning CT is the target and CT registered to the input.
size: 540 paired MRI-CT and 540 CBCT-CT sets (>500 patients per task) from three centers
description: Multi-center paired MRI-CT and CBCT-CT volumes of brain and pelvis (MHA format) for synthetic CT generation in radiotherapy, openly hosted on Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0.

label_schema: Ground-truth CT (ct.nii.gz) - the co-registered real CT that serves as the regression/image-translation target the model must synthesize
Binary body mask (mask.nii.gz) - value 1 = patient body / tissue region, value 0 = background air; defines the region over which image-similarity and dose metrics are evaluated
details.file_structure: Data is organized by task (Task 1 = MR->CT, Task 2 = CBCT->CT) and anatomy (brain, pelvis), with one folder per patient (IDs like 1BAxxx / 1PAxxx encoding task, Brain/Pelvis, and center) each containing the input (mr.nii.gz or cbct.nii.gz), the target ct.nii.gz, and a mask.nii.gz, all stored as compressed NIfTI (.nii.gz) converted from source DICOM.
details.splits: Multi-center set (UMC Utrecht, UMC Groningen, Radboud Nijmegen) of 540 paired MRI-CT and 540 CBCT-CT sets split across training / validation / test phases; validation and test ground-truth CTs are withheld from participants.
details.extra: This is an image-to-image synthesis (sCT generation) challenge, not a segmentation/classification task - the only pixel-level annotation is the binary patient body mask; there are no anatomical class labels.

name: FracAtlas
full_name: FracAtlas: A Dataset for Fracture Classification, Localization and Segmentation of Musculoskeletal Radiographs
protocol_note: Musculoskeletal X-ray radiographs of hand, leg, hip and shoulder; distributed as JPG.
size: ~4,073 X-ray images (717 fractured); ~338 MB
segmentation_detail: Pixel-level fracture segmentation masks (COCO/VGG polygon annotations)
description: A dataset of musculoskeletal X-ray radiographs of the hand, leg, hip and shoulder with fracture classification labels, bounding-box localization, and pixel-level segmentation annotations.

label_schema: Segmentation/localization: single object class - "fractured" (nc=1, only bone-fracture regions are annotated; no per-bone or fracture-type subclasses)
Localization: axis-aligned bounding boxes around each fracture instance
Segmentation: polygon masks delineating each fracture region
Per-image metadata in dataset.csv: body part (hand / leg / hip / shoulder), plus flags for multiple views/parts (mixed) and presence of orthopedic hardware/fixation
details.file_structure: Single FracAtlas.zip whose root holds images/ (JPG scans split into Fractured/ and Non_fractured/ subfolders), Annotations/ providing the same fracture labels in four parallel formats (COCO JSON with polygon segmentation masks, VGG JSON, PASCAL VOC XML bounding boxes, and YOLO .txt), a dataset.csv metadata table, and a utilities/ folder of format-conversion notebooks.
details.extra: Fracture-only annotations: 717 fractured images (922 fracture instances, 1-5 per image) vs 3,366 non-fractured; body-part breakdown ~ hand 1,538, leg 2,272, hip 338, shoulder 349. Total image count differs by source - the Scientific Data paper states 4,083, but the maintained figshare release now lists 4,073 and instructs users to trust the figshare values. No official train/val/test split ships with the dataset (the authors' XLR8-07/FracAtlas model repo supplies its own downstream train/valid/test CSVs).

name: Spine Generic (Multi-Subject)
full_name: Spine Generic Public Database - Multi-Subject
protocol_note: T1w, T2w, T2*, MT and DWI acquired with the spine-generic quantitative MRI protocol
size: ~260+ subjects, ~26 GB, 40+ sites
description: Multi-vendor, multi-site spinal cord MRI (T1w/T2w/T2*/MT/DWI) in BIDS/NIfTI format for quantitative MRI reproducibility and harmonization research.

label_schema: label-SC_seg - spinal cord segmentation (binary mask, value 1)
label-canal_seg - spinal canal / CSF-surrounding-cord segmentation (binary mask, value 1)
label-discs_dlabel - intervertebral disc point labels, integer-coded per disc level (e.g. C2/C3, C3/C4 ... down the cervical/upper-thoracic spine)
label-spine_dseg - vertebral level / spine segmentation labeled by level
label-rootlets_dseg - spinal nerve rootlets segmentation (provided on T2w)
Labels are provided per MRI contrast: T1w, T2w, T2star, MTS (flip-1_mt-on and flip-2_mt-off), and dwi (diffusion)
details.file_structure: BIDS-compliant layout: raw NIfTI images under sub-<site><NN>/anat (and /dwi), with labels stored as .nii.gz mask files plus matching .json sidecars under derivatives/labels/sub-<site><NN>/anat, filenames following BIDS derivative suffixes (e.g. sub-amu01_T2w_label-SC_seg.nii.gz); large files managed via git-annex.
details.extra: Multi-site, multi-vendor cervical spinal cord dataset acquired with the standardized spine-generic protocol; subjects are named by acquisition site (sub-amu01, sub-barcelona01, sub-hamburg05, etc.) and the full participant list lives in participants.tsv. Some disc labels on T2star/MTS are warped from another contrast (desc-warp). Licensed CC-BY-4.0.

name: ARCADE
full_name: Automatic Region-based Coronary Artery Disease diagnostics using x-ray angiography imagEs
protocol_note: X-ray coronary angiography frames (contrast) extracted from DICOM, 512x512 PNG
size: 1,500 training + 1,500 validation images (segmentation & stenosis tasks) plus 300 test images per task
segmentation_detail: COCO-format instance segmentation of 25+ coronary artery segments per SYNTAX score definitions and stenotic lesion regions
description: MICCAI 2023 challenge dataset of X-ray coronary angiography images with COCO-format instance-level annotations of coronary artery segments and stenotic plaques for automated coronary artery disease diagnostics.

label_schema: TASK 1 - Coronary artery segmentation: 26 vessel-segment instance classes (COCO category IDs 1-26) following SYNTAX Score coronary tree definitions
Segments use alphanumeric SYNTAX identifiers ranging from '1' to '16c' (main segment numbers 1-16 plus side branches denoted a/b/c), used as the class names in the annotation JSON

Confirmed example segment classes: 1 = RCA proximal, 2 = RCA mid, 3 = RCA distal, 5 = Left Main (LMCA), 6 = LAD proximal, 7 = LAD mid, 8 = LAD distal, 9/9a = diagonal branches, 11-13 = circumflex (LCX) proximal/distal, 14/14a/14b/15/16/16a-c = obtuse marginal / posterolateral branches (full 1:1 name-to-ID table per SYNTAX Score is not exhaustively reprinted in the paper)
TASK 2 - Stenosis detection: instance segmentation of stenotic lesion regions (a stenosis = coronary lesion with >=50% narrowing in a vessel >=1.5 mm thickness); single lesion-region annotation class
details.file_structure: Two separate sub-datasets (segmentation_dataset and stenosis_dataset), each split into train/val/test folders of 512x512 PNG X-ray angiography frames (extracted from DICOM) with labels in a single COCO-format JSON per split (categories with id 1-26, plus per-object polygon segmentation, XYWH bounding box, and area).
details.splits: Per task: 1000 train / 200 validation / 300 test images (1500 labeled images each for coronary artery segmentation and for stenosis detection).
details.extra: Released for the MICCAI 2023 ARCADE Grand Challenge; hosted on Zenodo (record 7981245, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10390295) with helper scripts for COCO-to-YOLO and mask-to-COCO conversion; evaluation metric is mean F1 with a 5 s/image inference limit. Documented in Scientific Data 2024 (PMC10764944).

name: CADICA
full_name: CADICA: a new dataset for coronary artery disease interpretation using invasive coronary angiography
anatomy: coronary arteries (left and right coronary artery)
protocol_note: Invasive coronary angiography videos acquired as DICOM at 10 fps (4-8 s), 512x512, converted to PNG frames; Siemens Artis Zee; 5-50 mGy per projection; LCA RAO/LAO cranial/caudal projections, RCA LAO/RAO cranial/caudal.
size: 42 patients; invasive coronary angiography videos, frames extracted to 512x512 PNG (1-151 frames per video, ~10 fps)
description: Invasive (fluoroscopic X-ray) coronary angiography dataset of 42 patients with manually labeled lesion bounding boxes and severity grading for computer-aided coronary artery disease detection.

label_schema: Lesion bounding boxes labeled by coronary stenosis severity (7 categories):
Each groundtruth line = x y w h <category> (top-left corner, width, height in pixels)
Videos also grouped clinically into 3 patient-level severity groups: mild (<20%), moderate (20-50%), severe (>70%)
Frame/video level: lesion vs non-lesion (selected videos where CAD is/ isn't visually present)
details.file_structure: CADICA/ contains metadata.xlsx plus nonselectedVideos/ and selectedVideos/; under selectedVideos/pX/vY/ are input/ (512x512 PNG frames), pX_vY_selectedFrames.txt (keyframe list), and for lesion videos a groundtruth/ folder with per-frame pX_vY_000ZZ.txt bounding-box files (x y w h category) plus a pX_vY_groundTruthTable.mat; lesionVideos.txt / nonlesionVideos.txt index videos per patient.
details.extra: 42 patients (Hospital Universitario Virgen de la Victoria), 668 ICA videos total of which 382 selected by the medical team; DICOM acquired at 10 fps, 512x512, 1-151 frames per video. Lesion label counts: p0_20=1944, p20_50=1128, p50_70=999, p70_90=893, p90_98=930, p99=63, p100=204. No official train/val/test split provided.

name: HiPaS
full_name: High-abundant Pulmonary Artery-vein Segmentation dataset
protocol_note: Non-contrast chest CT; volumes resampled to ~512x512x512 (~0.65x0.65x1.0 mm)
size: ~250 chest CT scans (ct_scan.zip 24 GB)
segmentation_detail: Separate binary pulmonary artery and vein masks for each chest CT scan
description: ~250 chest CT scans with separate pulmonary artery and vein segmentation masks (NPZ format), released with the 2025 Nature Communications HiPaS study and hosted openly on Zenodo under MIT license.

label_schema: Artery mask (annotation/artery/[id].npz): binary volume, 1 = pulmonary artery, 0 = background
Vein mask (annotation/vein/[id].npz): binary volume, 1 = pulmonary vein, 0 = background
details.file_structure: Non-contrast chest CT volumes in ct_scan.zip (ct_scan/[id].npz) with matching per-case binary masks in annotation.zip under separate annotation/artery/[id].npz and annotation/vein/[id].npz folders; all arrays are NumPy compressed .npz files read via the array key, plus a metadata.xlsx of case info.
details.extra: About 250 chest CT scans with artery-vein annotations are released publicly on Zenodo (a subset of the full study); volumes are resampled to ~512x512x512 (~0.65x0.65x1.0 mm). Annotations follow the PARSE22 standard. Accompanies Chu, Luo, Zhou et al., Nat Commun 16, 2262 (2025); code at github.com/Arturia-Pendragon-Iris/HiPaS_AV_Segmentation.

name: COSTA
full_name: COSTA: Multi-center and multi-vendor TOF-MRA CerebrOvascular SegmenTAtion database
protocol_note: TOF-MRA at 1.5T and 3.0T from 8 centers on 4 vendors (Philips, GE, Siemens, United Imaging); e.g. IXI-Guys 1.5T Philips Gyroscan Intera TR/TE 20/6.9 ms, ADAM 3.0T TR/TE 22/3.45 ms
size: 423 TOF-MRA volumes across 8 centers (4 vendors, 1.5T/3.0T)
segmentation_detail: Voxel-level cerebrovascular (arterial) segmentation masks for TOF-MRA volumes aggregated from 8 multi-center/multi-vendor cohorts (includes IXI, ADAM, ICBM, TubeTK subsets re-annotated plus additional centers)
description: Multi-center, multi-vendor annotated TOF-MRA database (423 volumes across 8 centers and 4 vendors) with voxel-level cerebrovascular segmentation labels, released with the 2024 IEEE TMI COSTA framework; access requires an approval request form on Zenodo.

label_schema: Label 1 - cerebrovascular / intracranial arteries (single foreground vessel class; binary voxel-level segmentation)
details.file_structure: 3D volumes and masks stored as compressed NIfTI (.nii.gz) in an nnU-Net Task-style layout (imagesTr / imagesTs with paired labelsTr / labelsTs), where TOF-MRA images use a _0000 (original) and _0001/_normed (intensity-normalized) suffix and each label file is a binary vessel mask aligned to its image, with a dataset.json describing the case list.
details.extra: COSTA aggregates 423 TOF-MRA volumes from 8 multi-vendor centers (IXI-Guys 60, IXI-HH 60, IXI-IOP 50, ADAM 107, ICBM 50, TubeTK-CoW 50, plus two local hospitals 27 and 19); segmentation is a single binary artery/vessel class, and the released code uses 5-fold cross-validation rather than a fixed official train/val/test split (IEEE TMI 2024; GitHub iMED-Lab/COSTA).

Clinical tabular data - set of biomarkers recognized as CAD risk factors

name: TN-Mammo

protocol_note: Full-field digital mammography, bilateral CC and MLO views (4 per exam), Thong Nhat Hospital PACS; v1.0.1 provides original DICOM (previous v1.0.0 was JPEG)
size: 676 exams (2,704 images, 4 views each)
description: Full-field digital screening mammography dataset of 676 four-view exams (2,704 JPEG images) from Thong Nhat Hospital, Vietnam, with radiologist BI-RADS breast density labels (A-D), released on PhysioNet under a restricted data use agreement.

label_schema: BI-RADS breast density category A - almost entirely fatty
BI-RADS breast density category B - scattered areas of fibroglandular density
BI-RADS breast density category C - heterogeneously dense
BI-RADS breast density category D - extremely dense
details.file_structure: JPEG images (converted from anonymized DICOM) are stored under datasets/TNMammo/images/[ID]/ with four files per exam (left_cc.jpg, left_mlo.jpg, right_cc.jpg, right_mlo.jpg), and a single TNMammo_labels.csv holds one density label per exam with columns ID, Labels (A/B/C/D), and Age.
details.extra: 676 exams / 2,704 images (4 views each: bilateral CC and MLO); one density label assigned per exam (not per breast/image) by two radiologists in double-blind fashion. No segmentation or bounding-box annotations are provided; no official train/val/test split.

name: NL-Breast-Screening
full_name: Newfoundland and Labrador Breast Screening (NLBS) Dataset
protocol_note: Full-field digital mammography, four-view screening exams (CC/MLO per breast), 16-bit DICOM
size: 5,997 four-view exams / 26,988 images / 5,935 patients; 90.8 GB download (3 .7z archives + metadata CSV)
description: Canadian (Newfoundland and Labrador) provincial full-field digital mammography breast-screening dataset of biopsy-confirmed four-view exams with radiologist assessments and false-positive read annotations, released under CC BY 4.0 on FRDR.

label_schema: Exam-level class by top folder: normal (4,332 exams / 19,942 images), False Positive (1,516 / 6,394), abnormal = cancer (149 / 652)

CSV 'Cancer': 1 = biopsy-confirmed cancer in that breast (breast-level; in abnormal exams only the cancer side is 1, 4 exams bilateral; the cancer side folder carries a '-c' suffix, e.g. right-c), 0 otherwise
CSV 'Hard to State Negative': 1 for the False Positive class (recalled by the screening radiologist, later shown negative), 0 otherwise
Per-image attributes: Image Laterality (L/R), View Position (CC/MLO), Age, Anode Target Material, Energy Settings, Window Center/Width, Collimator shape and edges (Exam Date column is empty)
No BI-RADS, breast density or lesion localization
details.file_structure: FRDR v3 (DOI 10.20383/103.01526): abnormal.7z (2.32 GB), False Positive.7z (22.57 GB), normal.7z (65.91 GB) and NLBSD_Metadata.csv (3.9 MB), total 90.8 GB; direct HTTPS links under https://www.frdr-dfdr.ca/repo/files/1/published/publication_1521/submitted_data/ (also Globus). Inside: <class>\p_<case>\<left|right>[-c]\<CC|MLO>\IM-*.dcm (16-bit DICOM, 2394x3062 or 1915x2295); one CSV row per image keyed by File Path.
details.extra: 26,988 images from 5,997 screening exams (5,935 unique patients); positives are biopsy-confirmed cancer and normals are verified cancer-free for >=2 years; the false-positive class (radiologist recalls that were benign) is the dataset's distinguishing feature. Source: FRDR record (DOI 10.20383/103.01526, v3) and paper arXiv:2411.02710 / Nature Sci Data 10.1038/s41597-025-05866-0.
details.label_readers: Labels come from the provincial screening program's records (screening radiologist's read and diagnostic work-up outcomes); no research re-reading
details.reference_standard: Cancer = biopsy-confirmed; normal = read normal and >=2 years cancer-free (no interval cancer); false positive = recalled by the radiologist, then shown normal/benign by biopsy or additional diagnostic imaging
details.version: v3 (2025-12-02); v1/v2 contain outdated directories and labels and are not recommended
details.third_party_note: FRDR data license is CC BY 4.0 (the Sci Data article itself is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Images were anonymized with HOROS (identifying fields blanked; equipment settings retained).

label_schema: Label 1 - brain arterial vessel (foreground; includes small/mesoscopic cerebral vessels down to ~mesoscopic scale)
Task is binary voxel-level vessel segmentation (single foreground class, vessel vs. non-vessel)
details.file_structure: Per-subject 7T Time-of-Flight MR angiography (TOF-MRA) volumes each paired with a corresponding voxel-level binary vessel segmentation mask, distributed as 3D NIfTI (.nii/.nii.gz) files organized by subject.

A separate 'Secret' external-validation dataset of 7 subjects scanned at 7T is fully withheld (images and labels).
details.extra: Ground-truth masks were created via automated pre-segmentation (thresholding in 3D Slicer) followed by extensive manual refinement of small vessels and verification by a senior neurologist; the challenge also provided auxiliary 'plausible' segmentations (Frangi-filter and OMELETTE pipeline variants). Base TOF-MRA images come from the StudyForrest project (healthy adult subjects).

name: SAROS
full_name: Sparsely Annotated Region and Organ Segmentation
anatomy: Whole-body body regions, body parts and organs: subcutaneous tissue, muscle, bones, thoracic/abdominal/pelvic cavities, mediastinum, pericardium, breast implant, brain, spinal cord, parotid/submandibular glands, thyroid; plus 6 body parts (torso, head, bilateral arms/legs)
protocol_note: Heterogeneous whole-body CT series drawn from 27 public TCIA collections; download script resamples CTs and labels to 5 mm slice thickness by default (original resolution optional).

segmentation_detail: Sparse slice-wise semantic segmentation of 13 body regions/organs and 6 body parts, aggregated from 27 public TCIA CT collections; download scripts pull source images from TCIA
description: A large heterogeneous, sparsely annotated whole-body CT dataset of 882 subjects providing semantic segmentations of body regions, body parts and organs for body composition analysis.

label_schema: Two separate sparse semantic segmentation label maps per case.

BODY-REGIONS (body-regions.nii.gz, from BodyRegions IntEnum): 0 - background, 1 - subcutaneous tissue, 2 - muscle, 3 - abdominal cavity, 4 - thoracic cavity, 5 - bone, 6 - parotid glands, 7 - pericardium, 8 - breast implant, 9 - mediastinum, 10 - brain, 11 - spinal cord, 12 - thyroid glands, 13 - submandibular glands
BODY-PARTS (body-parts.nii.gz, from BodyParts IntEnum): 0 - background, 1 - torso, 2 - head, 3 - right leg, 4 - left leg, 5 - right arm, 6 - left arm
details.file_structure: One folder per case (data/case_000/, case_001/, ...), each containing image.nii.gz plus two label volumes body-regions.nii.gz and body-parts.nii.gz (NIfTI, gzip, resampled to 5mm); the annotations are natively distributed on TCIA as DICOM-SEG and the repo's download.py pulls the source CTs from TCIA and converts everything to NIfTI, guided by a Segmentation-Info CSV.
details.extra: Sparse annotation: only a subset of axial slices per scan are labeled (aggregated from 27 public TCIA CT collections, some requiring TCIA restricted-license access); the two provided nnUNet baselines train separate 2D models for regions and for parts, and three cases (case_609, case_623, case_816) have abnormal HU values.

name: DAP Atlas

The official label_name.csv defines integer label values 0-131 (label 0 = background, label 1 = 'Left to annotate'); the paper (arXiv:2307.13375, 'Towards Unifying Anatomy Segmentation') describes the dataset as 142 voxel-level anatomical labels. Masks were automatically generated by aggregating multiple segmentation models and refined using anatomical guideline post-processing scripts included in the repo; the repo also ships two nnU-Net v1 models (Task901/Task902) trained with 5-fold cross-validation but no official fixed train/val/test split.

label_schema: Semantic segmentation masks: each mask is a binary PNG for one category-instance, and the category is encoded as a 4-digit numeric ID defined in SAMed2D_v1_class_mapping_id.json (name -> ID)
Mask filename suffix encodes '{categoryID}_{instanceID}', e.g. '0003_000' = liver, instance 0 (multiple instances of the same class distinguished by instance ID)

Categories span whole-body anatomy and lesions (organs, structures, and abnormalities) aggregated from ~30 public medical segmentation datasets; full per-ID class list is enumerated only inside SAMed2D_v1_class_mapping_id.json, not reproduced on the dataset card

details.extra: Scale: ~4.6M 2D images and ~19.7M masks (a ~16M-mask subset, SAMed2D_v1, is the publicly released version); modalities include CT, MRI, and X-ray. No official train/val/test split is provided.

label_schema: Label 1 - necrotic and non-enhancing tumor core (NCR/NET)
(alternative TCGA-LGG-Mask / Buda et al. dataset: single binary mask of FLAIR abnormality, foreground vs background)
details.file_structure: Raw collection is DICOM (MR + CT) organized by TCIA patient/study/series; the derived BraTS-TCGA-LGG analysis result provides, per subject, four co-registered skull-stripped MRI volumes (T1, T1-Gd/T1ce, T2, T2-FLAIR) plus one multi-class segmentation mask as NIfTI (.nii.gz) files, and the DICOM-Glioma-SEG result stores the same segmentations as DICOM-SEG (DSO) objects with a key mapping each DSO to its source DICOM Series UID.
