size: 1,255 sagittal T2-weighted cervical spine MRI exams / 1,232 patients; 491 exams (481 patients) manually segmented
segmentation_detail: Vertebral bodies (label 1, C2 to T1, incl. osteophytes, excl. posterior elements) and intervertebral discs (label 2, incl. herniations); manual on 491 exams, nnU-Net-generated weak labels on the remaining exams
description: Duke University Health System dataset of 1,255 non-contrast sagittal T2-weighted cervical spine MRI exams from 1,232 adults with expert manual vertebral body and intervertebral disc segmentations for 491 exams and model-generated segmentations for the rest.

label_schema: Label 1: vertebral bodies (binary, no level labels; C1 excluded; fused segments as one block; hardware excluded)
Label 2: intervertebral discs (entire disc incl. bulge/herniation, disc-osteophyte complex, adjacent endplates; PLL excluded)
Structured TSVs: demographics (age_at_index, sex, race, ethnicity) and MR series parameters (TE, TR, slice thickness, spacing, manufacturer)
details.file_structure: Four MIDRC downloads: Structured Data TSVs (6 files, e.g. Clinical_manifest_RSNA_20250321.tsv, mr_series_RSNA_20250321.tsv); MRI Image Files (./case_image/{Patient_ID}/{Study_Instance_UID}/{Series_Instance_UID}.zip of DICOM); Annotation Files (NIfTI converted with dcm2niix, {Patient_ID}/Study-MR-{Accession}/Series-{Series}/{Instance}.nii.gz); Segmentation Files (NIfTI masks with _SEG suffix).
details.splits: Paper experiments split the manually annotated exams into 391 development / 100 test; remaining exams are weakly labeled
details.label_readers: Six board-certified radiologists (5 neuroradiology, 1 MSK fellowship) and one post-doctoral researcher; postdoc drafted, one radiologist reviewed/revised and approved each exam; no multi-rater evaluation
details.reference_standard: Anatomical segmentation only; no pathology labels. Unannotated exams labeled by nnU-Net 2D/3D ensemble (test DSC 0.916) without manual review except mid-sagittal slice quality check
details.third_party_note: Users must register and 'strictly follow the MIDRC Data Use Agreement' (https://www.midrc.org/midrc-data-use-agreement); DUA terms on external services not verified.
details.extra: Exams from Dec 2019 to Nov 2020 ('MRI CERVICAL SPINE WITHOUT CONTRAST'); de-identified with RSNA DICOM Anonymizer v16 with date shifting preserving intervals. Paper: Zhou et al., Sci Data 12:1695 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-025-05975-w. Code: https://github.com/JikaiZ/CSpineSeg; model weights on request.

aliases: The Duke University Cervical Spine MRI Segmentation Dataset (CSpineSeg)

name: TOM500
full_name: TOM500: A Multi-Organ Annotated Orbital MRI Dataset for Thyroid Eye Disease
protocol_note: Coronal T2-weighted (T2-DRIVE TSE) orbital MRI, Philips Ingenia 3.0 T, slice thickness 3.5 mm, pixel spacing 0.3125 mm; volumes 512 x 512 x 20.
size: 500 coronal T2-weighted orbital MRI volumes / 500 patients (512 x 512 x 20)
segmentation_detail: Nine orbital structures: optic nerve, orbital fat, lacrimal gland, eyeball, superior rectus/levator palpebrae superioris complex, inferior rectus, medial rectus, lateral rectus, superior oblique
description: Coronal T2-weighted orbital MRI from 500 thyroid eye disease patients at Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital, in NIfTI format, with radiologist-reviewed segmentations of nine orbital structures and basic clinical data.

label_schema: Multi-label voxel masks for 9 orbital structures: ON, OF, LG, EB, SR (incl. levator complex), IR, MR, LR, SO
Clinical variables: sex, age, disease duration, smoking status (anonymized CSV)
clinical data: sex, age, disease duration, smoking status
details.file_structure: train/image and train/label (400 cases), val/image and val/label (100 cases); files named [patient id].nii.gz
details.splits: Suggested split: train 400 / val 100
details.label_readers: Three junior orbital radiologists segmented each scan blinded to disease status; their masks were fused with STAPLE and then reviewed and corrected by an expert orbital radiologist
details.reference_standard: All patients have clinically confirmed TED (EUGOGO criteria) at their initial visit; segmentations are STAPLE fusion followed by expert review
details.third_party_note: The data licence is not stated in the paper text retrieved; the code is CC0 on GitHub.
details.extra: Acquired 2016-2021 on a Philips Ingenia 3.0 T scanner with coronal T2-DRIVE TSE (slice thickness 3.5 mm, pixel spacing 0.3125 mm). Paper: Zhang et al., Sci Data 2025;12:60 (doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04427-9).

aliases: TOM500: A Multi-Organ Annotated Orbital MRI Dataset for Thyroid Eye Disease

name: TOMPEI-CMMD
full_name: TOMPEI-CMMD Dataset: lesion segmentations and corrected clinical data for the Chinese Mammography Database (CMMD)
protocol_note: Source CMMD full-field digital mammograms (GE Senographe DS); only MLO views annotated, CC views excluded
size: 1,773 segmentation masks on 1,385 breasts (MLO views) from 1,363 patients; clinical spreadsheet covering 2,436 breast images; ~25 MB
segmentation_detail: Polygon lesion masks (JSON cgPoints) tagged as mass, calcification, fibroadenoma, distortion, focal asymmetric density or lipoma; 255 benign, 1,515 malignant and 3 excluded lesions
description: TCIA analysis result adding radiologist-guided segmentation masks for 1,773 breast lesions on 1,385 MLO mammograms from 1,363 CMMD patients, together with a clinical spreadsheet that corrects laterality and view errors in the original CMMD labels.

label_schema: JSON per breast image: '_id' (patient), 'type' and 'color' of the finding, 'cgPoints' (polygon coordinates around the mask), 'x'/'y' lesion location
Finding tags: mass (blue), calcification (yellow), fibroadenoma (red), distortion (green), focal asymmetric density (purple), lipoma (light blue); an image can carry multiple tags
Clinical spreadsheet: classification, demographic, diagnosis and pathology detail, plus mask information and corrected L/R and CC/MLO labels
details.file_structure: Segmentations (JSON in ZIP, 24.8 MB; 1,385 JSON files) and a clinical data XLSX (624 KB) downloaded from TCIA; the source CMMD MG DICOM images (18.29 GB, 1,363 subjects, 4,162 images) require the TCIA Data Retriever.
details.label_readers: One board-certified breast radiologist with 20 years of experience assessed all 2,601 MLO images; five radiological technologists drew the segmentations under the radiologist's guidance
details.reference_standard: The radiologist read the images with prior knowledge of the original CMMD malignant/benign diagnoses; 140 images with mammographically occult lesions from patients with pathologically proven cancer and 25 images of insufficient quality were excluded. Only breasts with lesions have masks.
details.third_party_note: Segmentations, clinical data and source CMMD images are listed as CC BY 4.0; users must also abide by the TCIA Data Usage Policy and cite DOI 10.7937/WEZW-BH22.
details.extra: Uses MLO views only (CC views excluded); left and right breasts are treated as independent images. Sample viewer code is at https://github.com/javasparrows/TOMPEI-CMMD. Citation: Kashiwada Y. et al. (2025), TOMPEI-CMMD Dataset (Version 1), TCIA.

name: VALDO 2021
full_name: Where is VALDO? VAscular Lesions DetectiOn and segmentatiOn challenge (MICCAI 2021) — training dataset
protocol_note: Tasks 1 and 3: T1, T2, FLAIR co-registered to T1; Task 2: T2*, T2, T1 co-registered to T2*
size: 152 training subjects (Task 1 EPVS: 40, Task 2 microbleeds: 72, Task 3 lacunes: 40); ~5.8 GB
segmentation_detail: Enlarged perivascular spaces (12 of 40 Task 1 subjects; the rest have regional counts only), cerebral microbleeds (Task 2), lacunes (Task 3, two rater masks per subject)
description: Public training set of the MICCAI 2021 VALDO challenge: 152 defaced, co-registered multi-sequence brain MRIs from the SABRE, Rotterdam Scan Study and ALFA cohorts, with segmentations of enlarged perivascular spaces, cerebral microbleeds and lacunes.

label_schema: Task 1: EPVS voxel segmentations (two raters for 6 SABRE subjects, single rater for 6 RSS subjects) plus region masks with per-region EPVS counts (Count.csv) for all 40 subjects
Task 2: cerebral microbleed segmentation mask (70 of 72 subjects; 2 without mask)
Task 3: lacune segmentations from two raters per subject; one subject has an extra 'possible lacunes' mask
details.file_structure: Zenodo record 4520773: Task1.tar.gz (1.6 GB), Task2.tar.gz (2.6 GB), Task3.tar.gz (1.6 GB), README.md; BIDS-like Task{1,2,3}/sub-XXX/ folders with sub-{ID}_space-{Space}_desc-{Description}_{Suffix}.nii.gz files (per Hugging Face mirror README)
details.splits: Public training set only (152 cases); the 279-case test set is held out by the organisers and evaluated via container submission (per mirror README)
details.label_readers: Two raters per subject for Task 3 and for the 6 SABRE Task 1 subjects; a single rater otherwise (rater expertise not stated in the evidence)
details.reference_standard: Manual annotation. Where two rater masks exist, the paper's ground truth is their average thresholded at 0.5 (per mirror README). No histological confirmation.
details.third_party_note: The Zenodo description states 'licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License', while the Zenodo metadata lists CC BY-NC 4.0. Use is non-commercial; no explicit clause covers external services.
details.extra: Images are defaced, and the non-reference sequences are co-registered and resampled to the task's reference space. Subjects come from the SABRE (London), Rotterdam Scan Study and ALFA (Task 2 only) cohorts. The Zenodo record requests acknowledgement of funders and of the ALFA Study contributors for Task 2. Paper: Sudre et al., Medical Image Analysis 91:103029, 2024 (doi:10.1016/j.media.2023.103029).

aliases: VAscular Lesions DetectiOn and segmentatiOn challenge

name: VietPET-RoI
full_name: VietPET-RoI: Vietnamese whole-body PET/CT dataset with regional reports and 3D ROI bounding boxes
protocol_note: Whole-body PET/CT cropped into head_neck, chest and abdomen_pelvis regions; CT (D,512,512) int32, PET (D,256,256) float64, not normalized and not guaranteed to be SUV. The tracer is not stated (assumed FDG for the oncologic whole-body PET/CT), and CT contrast is not stated.
size: 200 patients / 600 CT-PET region pairs / 1,960 ROIs; ~135 GiB
paired_text_detail: Vietnamese regional radiology reports per body-region crop plus Vietnamese ROI descriptions
description: Vietnamese whole-body PET/CT dataset of 200 patients with six cancer types, providing cropped 3D CT/PET volumes for head-neck, chest and abdomen-pelvis regions, paired Vietnamese regional reports and 1,960 modality-specific 3D ROI bounding boxes.

label_schema: Per region pair: CT path, PET path, regional report path (train.json/val.json)
ROI boxes [x_min, y_min, z_min, x_max, y_max, z_max], zero-based, relative to the cropped volume, upper bound exclusive; separate CT and PET boxes
Disease group: lymphoma, lung, esophageal, thyroid, colorectal, head-and-neck cancer
3D ROI bounding boxes (separate CT and PET boxes)
disease group (lymphoma, lung, esophageal, thyroid, colorectal, head-and-neck cancer)
details.file_structure: train.json, val.json (CT/PET/report paths); train_roi.json, val_roi.json (split ROI annotations); combined_roi_reformat.json (canonical annotations for all 600 region pairs); disease directories containing .npy volumes (CT (D,512,512) int32; PET (D,256,256) float64, not normalized), regional reports and markup files.
details.splits: Patient-disjoint train 160 patients / 480 region pairs / 1,544 ROIs; validation 40 patients / 120 region pairs / 416 ROIs
details.third_party_note: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike); the card says 'Research use only' and asks users to treat the data as sensitive health data and not to attempt re-identification. Nothing is stated about external services.
details.extra: Paper: Nguyen et al., 'Region-Grounded Report Generation for 3D Medical Imaging: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Graph-Enhanced Framework', ACL 2026. Volumes are NumPy arrays; manifests contain no voxel spacing or physical geometry. PET values are not guaranteed to be SUV. Known issue: train_roi.json/val_roi.json reference '_processed.npy' paths, whereas the released files omit '_processed'. Reports may contain demographic and exam metadata. Possible overlap with the Vietnamese ViMed-PET-CT dataset (vimed-pet-ct) is not documented.

aliases: Region-Grounded Report Generation for 3D Medical Imaging: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Graph-Enhanced Framework

name: X-Raydar Multimodal
full_name: X-Raydar Multimodal Chest X-Ray Dataset
protocol_note: Frontal chest X-rays from three UK NHS hospital networks (2006–2019), extracted from DICOM as anonymised PNGs at native resolution
size: 979 frontal chest X-ray examinations
paired_text_detail: Original historical free-text radiology report per exam, with token-level span annotations (45 categories, IOBE tags) and derived report-level labels
license: Non-commercial (academic research and non-commercial evaluation only; terms at x-raydar.info)
description: 979 anonymised frontal chest X-rays from three UK NHS hospital networks (2006–2019) with radiologist-adjudicated labels for 37 findings, per-annotator bounding boxes, original reports and token-level report annotations.

label_schema: consensus_labels: image-level findings (37 classes, e.g. consolidation, cardiomegaly, pneumothorax, pleural effusion, rib fracture, volume loss)
bounding_boxes: label, annotator ID, x_min/y_min/x_max/y_max per finding from each of two radiologists independently
report_tokens / report_iobe_tags / report_spans: token-level finding spans (45 classes) from a separate annotation team
report_labels: report-level findings derived from report_spans
details.file_structure: images/{xray_id}.png (979 full-resolution PNGs); annotations.jsonl with one JSON object per exam (xray_id, image_file, consensus_labels, bounding_boxes, report_text, report_tokens, report_iobe_tags, report_spans, report_labels)
details.label_readers: Two experienced radiologists independently annotated each image (labels and boxes) using AnnotateX; disagreements on image labels adjudicated by a third senior radiologist. Report spans were annotated by a separate team (ten radiologists annotated 29,756 reports).
details.reference_standard: Radiologist consensus on the radiograph; no CT, pathology or clinical confirmation stated. Image labels reflect visible findings and report labels reflect written findings, so they may disagree.
details.third_party_note: README: 'For academic research and non-commercial evaluation only. See x-raydar.info for terms and conditions.' The full terms were not verified.
details.extra: Related to Cid et al., Lancet Digit Health 2024;6:e44-e57 (doi:10.1016/S2589-7500(23)00218-2) and Zhu et al., LREC-COLING 2024. The README says 37 classes but its table lists 38 entries (0-37). A companion text-only set, dnamodel/xraydar-reports, contains 29,756 annotated reports without images.
